ab.name: Abbasid Dynasty
ab.description: The Abbasid Dynasty pursues a flourishing Golden Age by concentrating structures around their House of Wisdom, allowing them to unlock significant economic advantages. The House of Wisdom also drives progress through the Ages and grants access to advanced technology. Abbasid camel units are expert at countering enemy cavalry.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Research unique technologies that benefit Camels, Military, Religion, Economy, and Trade.
Camel units reduce damage by -20% to nearby enemy horse cavalry.
Mills constructed near Berry Bushes create Orchards, increasing Food capacity by +100.
Gather from Berry Bushes +25% faster but cannot gather from Boar.
Berry carry capacity increased +3.
Land Traders are -33% cheaper.
Docks are -50% cheaper.
Age up without the need for Villagers by upgrading wings on the House of Wisdom.
Enter a Golden Age by constructing buildings in the House of Wisdom's influence, gaining bonuses across the empire.

overview.title: Pursuit of Knowledge
overview.description:
Embrace the Abbasids' pursuit of knowledge through researching unique technologies that benefit Camels, Military, Religion, Economy, and Trade.
Advance the ages by upgrading up to 4 Wings on the House of Wisdom.

overview.title: Camel Fighters
overview.description: Camels spook enemy horse cavalry with their presence, reducing their damage by -20%.

overview.title: Siege Experts
overview.description: Infantry can construct Rams, Siege Towers, Springalds, and Mangonels without the need for Siege Engineering technology.

overview.title: Grand Orchards
overview.description:
Cultivate Berry Bushes into Orchards by building Mills near them, increasing Food capacity by +100.
Villagers gather Berry Bushes 25% faster but cannot gather from Boar.
Villagers carry +3 Food from Berry Bushes.

overview.title: Trade Economy
overview.description: Land Traders are 33% cheaper.

overview.title: Dockyards
overview.description: Docks can be constructed for -50% Wood.

overview.title: Golden Age
overview.description:
Build towards your Golden Age – improving economy and technology.
Buildings within the House of Wisdom's influence receive +5 fire armor and contribute one point towards the Golden Age. The threshold for unlocks are 10, 20, 30, 50, and 75 buildings.
• Tier 1: Villager gather rate +15%
• Tier 2: Villager construction rate +20%
• Tier 3: Camel Riders +20% damage.
• Tier 4: Traders generate +20% gold.
• Tier 5: Melee Infantry +10% damage.

overview.title: Olive Oil
overview.description:
Collect a unique resource that is used to hire Mercenary units. Villagers gather Olive Oil equal to 50% of Food gathered from Berry Bushes, 15% from Olive Groves, and 10% from Shore Fish.
Fishing Boats generate Olive Oil equal to 20% of Food from Fish and Traders provide 20% Olive Oil based on the amount being traded.

overview.title: Mercenaries
overview.description: Purchase contracts or establish control of Trade Posts to recruit unique units from other civilizations with Olive Oil at the Mercenary House.

overview.title: Cisterns and Aqueducts
overview.description:

overview.title: Field Stones
overview.description: Gather Stone from every building constructed. Building size determines the amount of Stone collected.

overview.title: Golden Tent
overview.description:
The Golden Tent is the only landmark for the Golden Horde, which can be upgraded to advance to the next age and increase the health of the building. An edict can be chosen on the Golden Tent, which changes the influence or aura bonus provided by Fortified Outposts.
The Batu Khan and Torguud can be recruited from the Golden Tent.

overview.title: Hordes
overview.description: Units are produced in batches of two. Technologies can be researched that improve batch production.

overview.title: Stockyard
overview.description: Construct the Stockyard instead of Farms or Pastures for Food — Stockyards have Sheep carcasses which can be gathered and dropped off at the Stockyard directly.

overview.title: Fortified Outposts
overview.description: Fortified Outposts have more health and provide influence or aura bonuses depending on the Edict chosen on the Golden Tent.

overview.title: Augmented Transports
overview.description: Transport Ship landings are faster and more durable with +50% health and +15% move speed.

overview.title: Silk Road
overview.description:
Explore the Silk Road with Traders that receive extra resources from trades based on your total number of active Traders.
• 5+ Traders: +10% Food
• 10+ Traders: +10% Food, Wood
• 15+ Traders: +10% Food, Wood, Gold

overview.title: Stone Tech and Ovoos
overview.description: Construct Ovoo over Stone outcroppings to harvest Stone without the need for Villagers. The maximum number of Ovoos that can be built is increased +1 per age up.

overview.title: Scouting Falcon
overview.description: Scouts can deploy the Scouting Falcon ability to keep watch over the surrounding area.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Golden Horde Khan: Heavy Cavalry that scales in strength on age up. Can fire an arrow that increases the damage taken by enemies in an area. The Khan will also provide an increasing attack damage aura the longer the Khan is in combat.
Torguud: Heavy Cavalry which can protect the Khan, redirecting any damage taken by the Khan to the Torguud.
Kharash: Weak Light Melee Infantry units that provide armor to nearby allies.
Kipchak: Horse archer that can fire arrows which cause the target hit to bleed.
Traction Trebuchet: Faster move speed, setup time and attack speed.
Keshik: Heavy Cavalry available in Feudal Age, regenerates Health after every attack.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description:
Cheap ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ High rate of fire
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

baochuan.name: Baochuan
baochuan.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with broadside cannons.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Low movement speed

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

batu-khan.name: Batu Khan
batu-khan.description:
Melee cavalry leader that buffs the attack damage of nearby allies while the Khan is attacking. Can only be recruited from the Golden Tent.
+ Durable heavy cavalry
+ Automatically improves with each Age
- Only one Khan per Golden Horde player

bombard.name: Bombard
bombard.description:
Intimidating siege gun excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ High damage
- Must be set up to fire

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

explosive-junk.name: Explosive Junk
explosive-junk.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

fishing-boat.name: Fishing Boat
fishing-boat.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.
+ Can repair
- No combat

handcannoneer.name: Handcannoneer
handcannoneer.description:
Powerful all-purpose ranged infantry.
+ High damage
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

horseman.name: Early Horseman
horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

keshik.name: Keshik
keshik.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and a powerful charge attack. Effective against most units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
+ Restores health after every attack
- Less health than Lancers
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

kharash.name: Kharash
kharash.description:
Low health and damage melee infantry that passively increases the armor of nearby units.
+ Low cost and large recruitment batch 
- Weak against all types

kipchak-archer.name: Kipchak Archer
kipchak-archer.description:
Highly mobile ranged cavalry effective against slower melee units and will cause units hit to bleed. Any healing will remove the bleed.
+ High mobility
- Low damage
- Weak vs ranged units

light-junk.name: Light Junk
light-junk.description:
Light war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability and speed.
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

man-at-arms.name: Man-at-Arms
man-at-arms.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

rus-tribute.name: Rus Tribute
rus-tribute.description:
Rus heavy infantry called into service by the Golden Horde.
+ Faster than other heavy infantry
+ Faster attack speed
+ Additional damage against cavalry
- Less armored
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

scout.name: Scout
scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.description:
Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

torguud.name: Torguud
torguud.description:
Expensive cavalry with high health and melee armor. Effective against melee units. Protects the Khan when nearby by redirecting damage to themselves and can heal the Khan while out of combat. 
+ Heavy armor
+ High Health
+ Automatically improves with each Age
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

traction-trebuchet.name: Traction Trebuchet
traction-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a long distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
+ High mobility
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

transport-ship.name: Transport Ship
transport-ship.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat
- Unable to gather Stone (build an Ovoo to gather Stone)

war-junk.name: War Junk
war-junk.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

archery-range-reinforcements.name: Archery Range Reinforcements
archery-range-reinforcements.description: Archery Range batch production increased by +1, does not increase resource cost or time to recruit.

barracks-reinforcements.name: Barracks Reinforcements
barracks-reinforcements.description: Barracks batch production increased by +1, does not increase resource cost or time to recruit.

battlefield-salvage.name: Battlefield Salvage
battlefield-salvage.description: Kharash are equipped with shields, gaining +2 ranged armor, +2 melee armor, and increase their health by +25.

beachhead.name: Beachhead
beachhead.description: Rams gain an ability that will immobilize themselves, gaining strong defensive bonuses and allowing to fire multiple arrows.

earthen-core-walls.name: Earthen Core Walls
earthen-core-walls.description: Increase Fortified Outpost and Palisade fire armor by +3 and health by +300.

glorious-charge.name: Glorious Charge
glorious-charge.description: Adds the Glorious Charge ability to Outposts, when activated it starts a 10 second timer which reveals the Outpost and the nearby area to all players, when the timer ends all nearby allied units will get +50% movement speed and take -15% less damage for 30 seconds.

increased-supplies.name: Increased Supplies
increased-supplies.description: Increases production speed of Military Buildings by +50%.

khan-debuff-arrow.name: Khan Debuff Arrow
khan-debuff-arrow.description: The Khan can fire a signal arrow that reveals a 10 Tile range and makes enemies receive +10% damage in the targeted area for 10 seconds.

over-grazing.name: Over Grazing
over-grazing.description: Increase Stockyard gathering rate for Food by 10%. Does not apply to herded Sheep.

ovoo-ceremony.name: Ovoo Ceremony
ovoo-ceremony.description: Increases Ovoo Stone gather rate by 20%.

ovoo-offering.name: Ovoo Offering
ovoo-offering.description: Increases Ovoo Stone gather rate by 20%.

ovoo-tithe.name: Ovoo Tithe
ovoo-tithe.description: Ovoos provide an income of +60 Food, +60 Wood, and +10 Gold every minute.

padded-armor.name: Padded Armor
padded-armor.description: Increase Torguud and Horseman ranged and melee armor by +1 and health by +20

piracy.name: Piracy
piracy.description: Gain +25 Wood and +25 Gold when sinking an enemy ship.

rotation-grazing.name: Rotation Grazing
rotation-grazing.description: Increase Stockyard gathering rate for Food by 10%. Does not apply to herded Sheep.

sarai-lancers.name: Sarai Lancers
sarai-lancers.description: Increase Keshik healing by +1 Health per attack and attack speed by +10%. Torguud gain the same healing attack as the Keshik.

stables-reinforcements.name: Stables Reinforcements
stables-reinforcements.description: Stables batch production increased by +1, does not increase resource cost or time to recruit. The Torguud batch production is also increased by +1.

stone-commerce.name: Stone Commerce
stone-commerce.description: Traders supply +10% Stone to their trades.

triple-shot.name: Triple Shot
triple-shot.description: Kipchak Archers fire 2 additional arrows that each deal 70% less damage.

unlock-kharash-edict.name: Unlock Kharash Edict
unlock-kharash-edict.description: When the Kharash Edict is active the Golden Tent and Military Buildings within the influence of a Fortified Outpost produce an additional Kharash whenever any unit is recruited.

unlock-stockyard-edict.name: Unlock Stockyard Edict
unlock-stockyard-edict.description: When the Stockyard Edict is active Stockyards within the influence of a Fortified Outpost generate Gold while being worked.

elite-kipchak-archer.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-kipchak-archer.description: Upgrade Kipchak Archer to Elite Kipchak Archer.

golden-tent.name: Golden Tent
golden-tent.description:
Contains upgrades that will advance through the Ages. Batu Khan and his Torguud can be deployed to the field.
Can activate Edicts which will change the bonuses provided by Fortified Outposts.

monument-of-the-great-khan.name: Monument of the Great Khan
monument-of-the-great-khan.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

hr.name: Holy Roman Empire
hr.description: Prelates enhance the economy of the Holy Roman Empire, while powerful infantry units form the core of its military. Enemies must face an opponent able to rapidly recover from attacks and field strong counterattacks.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Place Relics in Outposts, Stone Towers and Keeps for defensive and economic bonuses.
Relics placed in Docks increase ship attack speed by +5% per Relic (Max +25%).
Early Man-at-Arms in the Feudal Age (II).
Infantry move 5% faster in the Dark Age (I) and 10% faster from the Feudal Age (II).
Emplacements are -20% cheaper. Outpost sight range increased by +20%.
Villagers carry +40% more resources.
Prelates can heal and use Holy Inspiration in the Dark Age (I) — inspired Villagers gather +40% faster for 30 seconds.
Buildings within influence of a Town Center gain the Emergency Repairs ability which can be activated to repair the building.
Universities provide population space and their technologies are cheaper.

overview.title: Religious Zeal
overview.description:
Demonstrate the might of the empire by placing Relics in Outposts, Towers, and Keeps - increasing their armor by +25%, damage by +25%, range by +25%, and line of sight by +20%.
Relics placed in Docks increase ship attack speed by +5% per Relic (Max +25%).
Relics placed in buildings generate +80 Gold per minute.

overview.title: Army of the Empire
overview.description: Infantry move 5% faster in the Dark Age (I) and 10% faster from the Feudal Age (II). Upgrade infantry with impactful technologies and field the Early Man-at-Arms in the Feudal Age (II).

overview.title: Emplacement Architecture
overview.description: All emplacement technologies are -20% cheaper. Outpost sight range increased by +20%.

overview.title: Pushcarts
overview.description: Villagers carry +40% more resources than other civilizations.

overview.title: Bursae
overview.description: Mandatory housing at Universities provides +30 population space at each University, and the freedom to choose curriculum reduces research costs at Universities by -10%.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Buildings constructed within the influence of a Town Center gain the Emergency Repairs ability which can be activated to repair the building for +150 health every second for 20 seconds.

concave-lens.description: Increases the Line of Sight of all Units and Ships by +2 tiles.

devoutness.description: Inspired Villagers gather resources +5% faster and construct buildings and defenses +25% quicker.

fire-stations.description: Military Ships regenerate +1 health every 2 seconds when out of combat.

heavy-maces.description: Men-at-Arms wield maces, increasing their bonus damage against heavy targets by +6.

inspired-warriors.description: Prelates increase their move speed by 10% and can inspire groups of military units, improving their armor by +1, and damage by +10%.

reinforced-defenses.description: Increase the health of walls, towers, and gates by +25%.

steel-barding.description: Grants Knights and Black Riders +2 melee and +2 ranged armor.

two-handed-weapons.name: Two-Handed Weapons
two-handed-weapons.description: Men-at-Arms wield two-handed weapons, increasing their damage by +2.

aachen-chapel.name: Aachen Chapel
aachen-chapel.description:
Inspires units in a large radius so long as a Prelate is garrisoned.
Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.

meinwerk-palace.name: Meinwerk Palace
meinwerk-palace.description: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.

burgrave-palace.description:
Acts as a Barracks that produces 400% faster.
Infantry gains +50% charge damage.

regnitz-cathedral.name: Regnitz Cathedral
regnitz-cathedral.description: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.

elzbach-palace.name: Elzbach Palace
elzbach-palace.description:
Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage.
Can train 8 Black Riders per Keep instead of 6.

palace-of-swabia.description:
Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost.

great-palace-of-flensburg.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

hl.name: House of Lancaster
hl.description: The House of Lancaster emerges as a powerful branch of English royalty. Manors are the backbone of the economy by providing sustainable economic practices. Lancaster military might is of technological advantage and superior tactics on the battlefield. Dismantle enemy formations with potent shock troops then pick them apart with superior ranged infantry.

list: Villagers gather from sheep +20% faster.
Build Manors to passively generate food and wood.
Town Centers spawn 4 sheep when built.
Keeps grant 3 free Earl's Guards when built.
Active Keeps improve the damage of Earl's Guards and Demilancers.
Villagers wield short bows when attacking enemy units.
Ships are -10% cheaper to produce.

overview.description:
Build Manors to generate passive income in the Feudal Age. Manors act as a drop off building for all resource types and provide +10 population space. Each Manor generates 30 food and 10 wood per minute, and an additional 4 food and 2 wood for each nearby villager.
Increase the build limit of Manors with unique technologies.

A powerful Lord of Lancaster, fights effectively and grants nearby military units +5% max health.
+ High health.
+ Improves nearby units.
- Slow movement.
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen.

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

monk.name: Monk
monk.description:
Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed

ribauldequin.name: Ribauldequin
ribauldequin.description:
Five-barreled gunpowder weapon effective against massed units. Deals little damage to buildings.
+ Can hit multiple targets in a single volley
- Short range
- Low ranged armor

scout.name: Scout
scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

transport-ship.name: Transport Ship
transport-ship.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
+ Uses a bow to attack
- Weak in combat

wynguard-army.name: Wynguard Army
wynguard-army.description: Produces an army of 2 Spearmen, 2 Crossbowmen, and a Trebuchet.

yeoman.name: Yeoman
yeoman.description:
Quick and long-ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ Long Range
+ Fast movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

admiralty.name: Admiralty
admiralty.description: Increase the range of combat ships by +1.

billmen.name: Billmen
billmen.description: Spearmen equip tempered Bills, reducing the armor of enemies by -1 when attacking.

burgundian-imports.name: Burgundian Imports
burgundian-imports.description: Importing Burgundian Handcannons enables Handcannoneers to be trained in the Castle Age and reduces Handcannoneer cost by -25%.

collar-of-esses.name: Collar of Esses
collar-of-esses.description: Your Knights and Demilancers adorn their armor with the Lancaster livery, gaining +5 bonus damage against enemy heavy units.

condensed-land-practices.name: Condensed Land Practices
condensed-land-practices.description: Advancements in feudal land distribution practices increase the build limit of Manors by +4 and their health by +100.

exact-militia-program.name: Exact Militia Program
exact-militia-program.description: Levy 10 Demilancers, 10 Earl's Guards, and 10 Yeomen.

hill-training.name: Hill Training
hill-training.description: Training in rugged terrain increases Hobelar charge damage by +125% and production speed by +100%.

military-tactics-training.name: Military Tactics Training
military-tactics-training.description: Advanced Military Tactics increase your troops' overall effectiveness in battle, improving their bonus damage by +20%.

open-field-system.name: Open Field System
open-field-system.description: Advancements in feudal land distribution practices increase the build limit of Manors by +4 and their health by +200.

padded-jack.name: Padded Jack
padded-jack.description: Equip your Yeomen and Spearmen with Padded Jacks, improving their melee armor by +3.

scutage.name: Scutage
scutage.description: The Lord of Lancaster levies a tax on all vassals to fund war efforts. Manors generate 30 gold per minute.

ships-of-the-crown.name: Ships of the Crown
ships-of-the-crown.description: Investing in bigger and better ship hulls increases Carrack damage by 20%, health by 15%, and range by 10%.

synchronized-shot.name: Synchronized Shot
synchronized-shot.description: Unlocks the Synchronized Shot ability for Yeomen.

throwing-dagger-drills.name: Throwing Dagger Drills
throwing-dagger-drills.description:
Earl's Guards are supplied with additional Daggers when throwing, these Daggers also deal a small amount of area damage.
Earl's Guards now throw 2 Daggers but are less accurate.

warwolf-trebuchet.name: Warwolf Trebuchet
warwolf-trebuchet.description: Experience from building larger trebuchets increases their range by +2 and health by +50%.

abbey-of-kings.name: Abbey of Kings
abbey-of-kings.description:
Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds.
Ordain up to 4 Lords of Lancaster, powerful melee leaders which increase the max health of nearby military units by +5% each. Queues production of a free Lord of Lancaster upon completion.

lancaster-castle.name: Lancaster Castle
lancaster-castle.description:
Defensive Landmark that can do a one-time muster of units in each Age. The cost of mustering units is reduced by 50 resources per Manor.
Grants all Manors +500 health and an arrowslit emplacement.

kings-college.name: King's College
kings-college.description:
Reduces research costs of all technologies by -20%.
Contains unique Military technologies for House of Lancaster.

the-white-tower.name: The White Tower
the-white-tower.description:
Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses.
Grants 3 Earl's Guard upon being fully constructed.

berkshire-palace.name: Berkshire Palace
berkshire-palace.description:
Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.
Increases the maximum damage granted by a House Unified to +6. Also grants 3 Earl's Guard upon being fully constructed.

wynguard-palace.name: Wynguard Palace
wynguard-palace.description: Allows the production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Earl's Retinue, Garrison Command, and Gunpowder Contingent.

cathedral-of-st-thomas.name: Cathedral of St. Thomas
cathedral-of-st-thomas.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

ja.name: Japanese
ja.description: Ruling over the Japanese land, the Daimyo enhances agriculture and employs Samurai to defend their territory. The unique Forge works tirelessly to sharpen their blades to give an edge in battle. Fierce Samurai Bannermen lead their diverse army of infantry and cavalry to victory.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Town Centers can be upgraded to improve defenses, harvest rates of nearby Farms, and the production cap of Samurai Bannermen.
Samurai Bannermen provide bonuses to nearby infantry and cavalry.
Samurai have Deflective Armor that can block ranged or melee attacks.
Barracks are cheaper to build.
Farmhouses are Food drop-off sites in addition to providing Population.
Forges are Gold and Stone drop-off sites in addition to containing military upgrades.
Gold deposited by Villagers generates bonus Stone and vice versa.
Extra melee damage upgrade accessible in the Dark Age (I).
Choose between Buddhist Monks or Shinto Priests with your choice of Castle Age (III) Landmark.
Keeps come equipped with Rocket Emplacements and increased health in the Imperial Age (IV).
Fishing Boats are cheaper to produce.

overview.title: Daimyo
overview.description: Town Centers can be upgraded into special buildings called the Daimyo Manor, Daimyo Palace, and Shogunate Castle. These buildings provide bonuses to nearby Villagers working Farms by 20%, 40%, 60%, increases the capacity of Samurai Bannerman by +1, +2, +3, and improves its defenses.

overview.title: Hatamoto Samurai
overview.description: Field elite Samurai Bannermen that increase the damage of nearby infantry by +15% and cavalry by +10%. Bannermen Samurai drop their banners when killed, providing the same effect for a duration.

overview.title: Calm of Mind
overview.description: Produce Samurai in the Dark Age (I). Samurai have the Deflective Armor ability which can periodically block melee or ranged attacks.

overview.title: Farmhouse & Forge
overview.description: The Forge is a Gold and Stone drop-off and replaces the Mining Camp and Blacksmith. Additionally, it provides extra melee damage technology in the Dark Age (I). The Farmhouse both provides population and replaces the Mill as a Food drop-off.

overview.title: Oda's Fortress
overview.description: Access a more powerful Keep in the Imperial Age (IV) that comes with increased health and Rocket Emplacements for a higher cost. Rockets attack quickly and deal massive damage to single targets.

overview.title: Silver Mining
overview.description: When Villagers deposit Gold, 20% extra Stone is also produced and vice versa.

overview.title: Religious Choice
overview.description: Select between Shinto and Buddhism with your choice of Age III Landmark. If choosing Shinto, you unlock the Shinto Priest. If choosing Buddhism, you unlock the Buddhist Monk. These religious units offer unique bonuses.

overview.title: Samurai Districts
overview.description: Barracks are 50% cheaper to construct.

overview.title: Fishing Village
overview.description: Fishing Boats are produced 25% cheaper.

overview.title: Unique Units
list: Samurai: Man-at-Arms replacement. Heavy melee infantry that have Deflective Armor which can block melee and ranged attacks.
Mounted Samurai: Lancer replacement. Heavy melee cavalry with Deflective Armor.
Yumi Ashigaru: Archer with improved move speed for reduced cost and health.
Onna-Bugeisha: Light melee infantry that can use their fast move speed and long weapon range to keep their opponent on alert.
Onna-Musha: Crossbowman replacement. Cavalry Archer that can use increased mobility to harass heavy targets.
Shinobi: Espionage unit that can act as a spy, sabotage buildings, or assassinate targets. Produced from the Koka Township Landmark.
Ozutsu: Heavy ranged gunpowder infantry that has a huge handheld cannon with high siege and splash damage. Produced from the Tanegashima Gunsmith Landmark.

atakebune.name: Atakebune
atakebune.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with rockets.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Vulnerable vs. Incendiary Ships
- Low movement speed

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

bombard.name: Bombard
bombard.description:
Intimidating siege gun excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ High damage
- Must be set up to fire

buddhist-monk.name: Buddhist Monk
buddhist-monk.description:
Support unit with the ability to decrease enemy attack damage. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Reduced cost
+ Conversion enhances friendly unit damage
+ Automatically reduces enemy attack damage
+ Heals units

counterweight-trebuchet.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
counterweight-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

explosive-junk.name: Explosive Junk
explosive-junk.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

fishing-boat.name: Fishing Boat
fishing-boat.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.
+ Can repair
- No combat

handcannon-ashigaru.description:
Powerful all-purpose ranged infantry.
+ High damage
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

junk.name: Junk
junk.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

katana-bannerman.description:
Samurai with an aura that increases damage of melee infantry. Comes with the Deflective Armor ability that periodically blocks attacks.
+ Banner drops on death
+ Heavy armor
+ Increased move speed
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units

mounted-samurai.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and a powerful charge attack. Comes with the Deflective Armor ability that periodically blocks attacks.
+ Heavy armor
+ Deflective Armor recharges out of combat
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

onna-bugeisha.description:
Light melee infantry with fast attack speed and long weapon range.
+ Fast attack speed
+ Fast move speed
+ Long weapon range
- Weak against heavy targets
- Countered by Archers, Knights

onna-musha.name: Onna-Musha
onna-musha.description:
Highly mobile ranged cavalry effective against heavy units.
+ Fast move speed
+ Long weapon range
+ Bonus damage vs. heavy units
- Weak vs ranged units

ozutsu.name: Ozutsu
ozutsu.description:
Ranged infantry equipped with a huge gunpowder weapon that has good weapon range, siege, and splash damage.
+ Anti-building
+ Area damage
- Slow move speed
- Slow attack speed
- Countered by Horsemen and Crossbowmen

ribauldequin.description:

+ Can hit multiple targets in a single volley
- Short range

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.description:
Heavy infantry with good damage and defense. Comes with the Deflective Armor ability that periodically blocks attacks.
+ Heavy armor
+ Deflective Armor recharges out of combat
- Slow move speed
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

shinobi.name: Shinobi
shinobi.description:
Melee infantry that specializes in scouting, sabotage, and assassination.
+ Disguise as enemy Villagers
+ Bonus damage vs. melee
+ Health regeneration
- Capital Town Centers, Outposts, and Scouts can spot disguises

Heals passively.

shinto-priest.name: Shinto Priest
shinto-priest.description:
Support unit with unique privileges to hold and deposit Yorishiro into buildings. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Yorishiro provide unique bonuses
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow move speed

uma-bannerman.description:
Mounted Samurai with an aura that increases damage of cavalry. Comes with the Deflective Armor ability that periodically blocks attacks.
+ Banner drops on death
+ Fast move speed
+ Heavy armor
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat.
When 5 or more stone is deposited an extra 20% gold is produced and when 5 or more gold is deposited an extra 20% stone is produced.

war-junk.name: War Junk
war-junk.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

yumi-ashigaru.name: Yumi Ashigaru
yumi-ashigaru.description:
Quick and cheap ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ Increased move speed
+ Cheaper than Archers
- Reduced health
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

yumi-bannerman.name: Yumi Bannerman
yumi-bannerman.description:
Ranged Samurai with an aura that increases damage of ranged infantry. Comes with the Deflective Armor ability that periodically blocks attacks.
+ Banner drops on death
+ Fast move speed
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

bunrei.name: Bunrei
bunrei.description: Increases the maximum number of Yorishiro by +2. Immediately produces 2 Yorishiro at the Floating Gate.

copper-plating.name: Copper Plating
copper-plating.description: Improves the fire and ranged armor of ships by +2.

daimyo-manor.name: Daimyo Manor
daimyo-manor.description:
Increases the production cap of Bannerman Samurai by +1 and provides a free Villager.
Increases Town Center health by +1000, adds an additional arrow slit, and adds an aura which enhances Villagers harvest rate from Farms by +20%.

daimyo-palace.name: Daimyo Palace
daimyo-palace.description:
Increases the production cap of Bannerman Samurai by +2 and provides a free Villager.
Increases Town Center health by +2000, fire armor by +2, adds an additional arrow slit, and adds an aura which enhances Villagers harvest rate from Farms by +40%.

do-maru-armor.name: Do-maru Armor
do-maru-armor.description: Increase Mounted Samurai move speed by +10% while Deflective Armor is active.

five-mountain-ministries.name: Five Mountain Ministries
five-mountain-ministries.description: Buddhist Temples cast Sohei Sutra on a nearby enemy every 6 seconds.

fudasashi.name: Fudasashi
fudasashi.description: Increase the carry capacity of Villagers by +3, their movement speed by +7%, and +25% gather rate from Berry Bushes.

gion-festival.name: Gion Festival
gion-festival.description: Increases the Line of Sight of all buildings by +2 tiles. Every 3 minutes, all economic units heal for 100% of their health over 3 seconds.

hizukuri.name: Hizukuri
hizukuri.description: Increase the melee damage of all non-siege units by +1.

kabura-ya-whistling-arrow.name: Kabura-ya Whistling Arrow
kabura-ya-whistling-arrow.description: Onna-Musha fire a whistling arrow when an enemy is seen, increasing move speed for 10 seconds.

kobuse-gitae.name: Kobuse-gitae
kobuse-gitae.description: Increase the melee damage of all non-siege units by +1.

nagae-yari.name: Nagae Yari
nagae-yari.description: Spearmen are equipped with a stronger spear that increases weapon range by +20% and damage against cavalry by +15%.

nehan.name: Nehan
nehan.description: Upgrades Buddhist Conversion to Nehan Conversion, which has a 25% shorter cooldown and additionally improves nearby allied units movement speed by +25% when cast.

oda-tactics.name: Oda Tactics
oda-tactics.description: Tactics from powerful daimyo improves melee infantry, increasing their damage by +15%, torch damage by +15%, and +15% health.

odachi.name: Odachi
odachi.description: Equip Samurai with an Odachi, a long sword that deals +4 bonus damage against infantry.

shinto-rituals.name: Shinto Rituals
shinto-rituals.description: Increases Shinto Priest health by +40, healing rate by +60%, and movement speed by +15%.

shogunate-castle.name: Shogunate Castle
shogunate-castle.description:
Increases the production cap of Bannerman Samurai by +3 and provides a free Villager.
Increases Town Center health by +3000, fire armor by +3, adds an aura which enhances Villagers harvest rate from Farms by +60%, and equips a Rocket Emplacement.

takezaiku.name: Takezaiku
takezaiku.description: Increase the carry capacity of Villagers by +3, their movement speed by +7%, and +25% gather rate from Berry Bushes.

tatara.name: Tatara
tatara.description: Increase the melee damage of all non-siege units by +1.

tawara.name: Tawara
tawara.description: Increase the carry capacity of Villagers by +3, their movement speed by +7%, and +25% gather rate from Berry Bushes.

yaki-ire.name: Yaki-ire
yaki-ire.description: Increase the melee damage of all non-siege units by +1.

zen.name: Zen
zen.description: Buddhist Monks generate 25 gold every 60 seconds.

elite-yumi-ashigaru.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-yumi-ashigaru.description: Upgrade Veteran Yumi Ashigaru to Elite Yumi Ashigaru.

veteran-yumi-ashigaru.name: Upgrade to Veteran
veteran-yumi-ashigaru.description: Upgrade Yumi Ashigaru to Veteran Yumi Ashigaru.

koka-township.name: Koka Township
koka-township.description: Can produce Shinobi espionage units which specialize in scouting, sabotage, and assassination. Queues production of a free Shinobi upon completion.

kura-storehouse.name: Kura Storehouse
kura-storehouse.description: Universal drop-off location that creates a Farm around the Landmark every 50 seconds — generates Wood instead when farmland becomes full.

floating-gate.name: Floating Gate
floating-gate.description:
Produces a Shinto Priest carrying a Yorishiro every 2 minutes. The first priest spawns instantly. Deposit up to 4 Yorishiro in buildings to provide unique bonuses.
 
Unlocks Shinto Shrines, which contains unique Shinto technologies and produces Shinto Priests.

temple-of-equality.name: Temple of Equality
temple-of-equality.description:
Produces Buddhist Monks and contains unique Buddhist technologies. Buddhist Monks and Buddhist Temples provide support in combat by decreasing enemy damage with Sohei's Sutra. Buddhist monks enhance the damage of nearby units when using Buddhist Conversion.
 
Also allows construction of 4 additional Buddhist Temples.

castle-of-the-crow.name: Castle of the Crow
castle-of-the-crow.description: Acts as a Castle. Can periodically spawn Treasure Caravans from selected neutral Trading Posts to provide a large amount of Food, Wood, Gold, and some Stone when reaching the Castle of the Crow.

tanegashima-gunsmith.name: Tanegashima Gunsmith
tanegashima-gunsmith.description: Stockpiles weapon supplies every 30 seconds that can be used to instantly produce gunpowder units - comes with 2 stockpiles. Produces Ozutsu, a unique heavy ranged gunpowder infantry with siege damage. Allows access to Ribauldequins.

tokugawa-shrine.name: Tokugawa Shrine
tokugawa-shrine.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

je.name: Jeanne d'Arc
je.description: A spark of hope for the French people, Jeanne d'Arc takes to the battlefield and inspires courage to her followers. Starting as a humble villager, Jeanne begins the Journey of a Hero in the Dark Age. Experience forges Jeanne into a powerful leader, gaining access to trusted companions and powerful abilities which shape the empire she was destined to create.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Jeanne d'Arc navigates the Journey of a Hero.
Royal Knights in the Feudal Age (II).
Economic technologies are -35% cheaper.
Trade Posts are revealed on the minimap.
Traders can return Food, Wood, or Gold to Markets.
Trade Ships return +20% resources.

overview.title: Journey of a Hero
overview.description:
Jeanne d'Arc is present on the battlefield. A heroic unit who gains experience for completing tasks such as gathering resources, constructing buildings, and participating in combat.
After accruing enough experience, Jeanne may level up to obtain powerful economic and combat abilities.

overview.title: Royal Stallions
overview.description: Deploy the Royal Knight in the Feudal Age (II) and research powerful unique technologies for cavalry.

overview.title: Galvanized Economy
overview.description: The people work harder under Jeanne d'Arc's leadership. Economic upgrades are 35% cheaper.

overview.title: Trade Economy
overview.description:
Choose to return Food, Wood, or Gold to Markets with Traders and Trade Ships.
Trade Ships return +20% more resources.
Trade Posts are revealed on the minimap at the start of the game.
Docks provide populations space.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Jeanne d'Arc: A hero unit that starts as a villager, Jeanne begins the Journey of a Hero to gain powerful abilities.
Jeanne's Rider: Fast Cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering Crossbows, becomes available once Jeanne achieves level 3.
Jeanne's Champion: Tough infantry that excels at countering Spearmen, becomes available once Jeanne achieves level 3.
Royal Knight: Heavy Cavalry that gains +3 bonus damage for 5 seconds after completing a charge.
Arbalétrier: Crossbowman with +1 melee armor that can deploy a defensive Pavise to provide +5 ranged armor and +1 weapon range for 30 seconds.
Cannon: Bombard replacement with more damage, mobility and no setup time.
Galleass: Large war galley that has a long range forward mounted bombard.
War Cog: Unique Springald Ship with reduced cost and increased pierce armor.

- Lower maneuverability

+ Good damage vs buildings
- Countered only by superior numbers

jeanne-darc-hunter.description:

+ High rate of fire
- Countered by Horsemen

jeanne-darc-knight.name: Jeanne d'Arc - Knight
jeanne-darc-knight.description:

+ Heavy armor
+ Fast movement
- Countered by Spearmen

jeanne-darc-markswoman.name: Jeanne d'Arc - Markswoman
jeanne-darc-markswoman.description:

+ Heavy armor 
+ Long range 
+ Good damage vs buildings

jeanne-darc-mounted-archer.name: Jeanne d'Arc - Mounted Archer
jeanne-darc-mounted-archer.description:

+ Long range
+ Good damage
- Countered by Horsemen

jeanne-darc-peasant.name: Jeanne d'Arc - Peasant
jeanne-darc-peasant.description:

 - Weak in combat

jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms.name: Jeanne d'Arc - Woman-at-Arms
jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms.description:

+ Heavy armor
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

- Countered by Spearmen

man-at-arms.description:

mangonel.description:

monk.description:

ribauldequin.name: Ribauldequin
ribauldequin.description:

- Short range
- Low ranged armor

royal-cannon.name: Royal Cannon
royal-cannon.description:
Most powerful siege cannon. Excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ Bonus damage to buildings

royal-knight.name: Royal Knight
royal-knight.description:
Gain bonus damage for 5 seconds after charging. Effective against most units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

royal-ribauldequin.name: Royal Ribauldequin
royal-ribauldequin.description:
Five-barreled gunpowder weapon effective against massed units. Deals little damage to buildings.

+ Can Fortify to deploy Palings and gain range
- Short range
- Low ranged armor

scout.description:

+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed

siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.

- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants

- Countered by Archers

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

transport-ship.name: Transport Ship
transport-ship.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat

cantled-saddles.name: Cantled Saddles
cantled-saddles.description: Increase Royal Knights' bonus damage after a charge from +3 to +10.

chivalry.name: Chivalry
chivalry.description: Royal Knights regenerate +1 health every 1 seconds when out of combat.

companion-equipment.name: Companion Equipment
companion-equipment.description: Increase Jeanne d'Arc's health and damage by 25% and gain +1 armor. Increase the health and damage of Jeanne's Companions by 20%.

crossbow-stirrups.name: Crossbow Stirrups
crossbow-stirrups.description: Increase the attack speed of Arbalétriers by +25%.

long-guns.name: Long Guns
long-guns.description: Increase the damage of naval cannons by +15%.

merchant-guilds.name: Merchant Guilds
merchant-guilds.description: Active Traders generate 1 gold every 6 seconds.

ordinance-company.name: Ordinance Company
ordinance-company.description: Consecrated buildings also reduce the Wood and Gold cost of units by 25%.

royal-bloodlines.name: Royal Bloodlines
royal-bloodlines.description: Fill the stables with the best stallions, increasing all cavalry health by +35%.

chamber-of-commerce.name: Chamber of Commerce
chamber-of-commerce.description: Acts as a Market. Trains one free Trader for each economic technology researched.

school-of-cavalry.name: School of Cavalry
school-of-cavalry.description: Acts as a Stable. All of your stables produce units +20% faster.

guild-hall.name: Guild Hall
guild-hall.description: Generates and stores resources over time, the more resources stored the faster they are generated. Select between Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold. Generates stone at half the rate.

royal-institute.name: Royal Institute
royal-institute.description: Houses unique technologies. Research is -30% cheaper here and ignores Age requirements.

college-of-artillery.name: College of Artillery
college-of-artillery.description:
Produces the Royal versions of the Cannon and Ribauldequin, which do +30% more damage and cost -25% gold.
Royal Cannons gain the Artillery Shot ability and Royal Ribauldequins gain the Fortify ability.
Contains Siege and Gunpowder technologies, trains units and researches technologies 50% faster.

red-palace.name: Red Palace
red-palace.description:
Acts as a Keep. Features high-damage arbalest emplacements. Each garrisoned unit adds an additional arbalest.
Activates an Arbalest emplacement on all Keeps and Town Centers.

notre-dame.name: Notre Dame
notre-dame.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

jin.name: Jin Dynasty
jin.description: The Jin Dynasty emerges as a formidable military power in northern China. Mounted Villagers move swiftly to claim new resources and land. Seize opportunities and rally hosts of cavalry at a moment's notice to rout enemies and crush opposition. Bribe weak-willed enemies into desertion and establish profitable Tributary States.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Train up to 20 Mounted Villagers, which gather and move significantly faster than a standard villager.
Select from three locations upon age up to build a Grassland.
Build War Stables near Grasslands to quickly produce Cavalry with Horses.
Emissaries can Establish Tributaries and Bribe enemy soldiers.
Tributaries generate Food, improve Trader income by +15%, and increase Mounted Villager build limit by +3.
Meng'an Mouke emplacements call upon defenders to protect nearby land.
Bed Crossbows are available in Feudal Age, replacing Springalds.

overview.title: Grasslands
overview.description: Select from 3 locations upon completing a Landmark to build Grasslands, which gradually spawn up to 5 Horses in their field. Horses increase the health of all Melee Cavalry units by +2 and all Ranged Cavalry by +1, or can be used by Stables within the Influence of the Grasslands to quickly train any mounted unit. Grasslands produce a new Horse every 75/60/45 seconds in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Ages.

overview.title: Jurchen Legacy
overview.description: Nomadic ancestry allows up to 20 Mounted Villagers which gather, construct, and move significantly faster but cost more. Establish Tributary States with Trade Posts to increase the maximum build limit by +3.

overview.title: Meng'an Mouke
overview.description: Upgrade defensive structures with the Meng'an Mouke Emplacements, which send out defenders to protect nearby lands. Emplacements also slowly produce defenders to replenish losses.

overview.title: Emissaries
overview.description:
Train up to 2 Emissaries which come equipped with two powerful abilities.
Establish Tributaries on Neutral Trade Settlements to gain a loyal ally, which will gather food on your behalf, increases Mounted Villager build limit by +3, and increases your traders income by +15%.
Cast Bribe on groups of enemy units, turning foes into neutral fighters who will combat anything in their way.

overview.title: Siege Expertise
overview.description: Build the Machine Workshop in Feudal Age granting early access to Bed Crossbows, a springald replacement which fires two projectiles into enemy formations. Bed Crossbow Emplacements replace Springald Emplacements at all defensive structures.

overview.title: Unique Units
list: Mounted Villager - Unique villager that gathers, builds, and moves significantly faster than a standard villager.
Emissary - Support unit which can bribe enemy soldiers and establish Tributary States.
Iron Pagoda - Heavy Cavalry encased from head to toe in armor, deals area damage on every attack.
Bed Crossbow - Springald replacement that fires a volley of projectiles at once, available in the Feudal Age.
Eruptor - Expensive Handcannon replacement that deals high single target damage.
Mohe Tribesman - Mounted archer replacement. Exceptional at hit and run tactics against light melee infantry.
Zhanma Swordsman - Armored Infantry available only in Imperial Age, deals impressive melee damage with bonus against cavalry.
Meng'an Mouke Defenders - Meng'an Mouke & Mounted Grenadiers spawn from unique emplacements to automatically defend Jin territory.

bed-crossbow-emplacement.description: Add a defensive Bed Crossbow Emplacement to this building.

collective-hunting.description: Local tribes offer some of their Reindeer as tribute. Spawns 4 Reindeer under your Town Center.

draft-horses.description: Increases Villagers' Wood gather rate by 15% and increases their Wood carry capacity by 10.

flying-fire-battalions.name: Flying Fire Battalions
flying-fire-battalions.description: The Jin Dynasty consolidates its power and reinforces the Meng'an Mouke system to face incoming threats. Defenders are now supported by Mounted Grenadiers, and the available number of Defenders is increased by +10.

handcannon-slits.name: Handcannon Slits
handcannon-slits.description: Add defensive handcannon slits to this structure and increases garrison arrow range by +1. Only one weapon emplacement can be added.

heaven-shaking-thunder.description: The thunderous sounds of Eruptor and Storm Lance weapons scares enemy cavalry, reducing the damage of nearby cavalry by 20% for 5 seconds.

hunting-tradition.description: Increase Villagers' hunted meat gather rate by +20%.

lightweight-frames.description: Increase the movement speed of siege engines by +10%.

mengan-mouke-emplacement.name: Meng'an Mouke Emplacement
mengan-mouke-emplacement.description:

Produces 1 global Meng'an Mouke Defender every 60 seconds.

mohe-ancestry.name: Mohe Ancestry

naval-crossbows.name: Naval Crossbows
naval-crossbows.description: Replaces Springald Ship weaponry with repeating Bed Crossbows that fire bursts of 2 piercing bolts.

padded-lamellar.description: Industrious blacksmithing yields stronger lamellar armor for the army. All Cavalry and Melee Infantry health increased by +25%.

pili-pao.name: Pili Pao
pili-pao.description: Explosive Grenades hurled by Trebuchets and Nest of Bees smoke out enemy defenders, reducing attacked building damage by 20% for 8 seconds. Trebuchets and Nest of Bees gain +1 range.

porcupine-defense.name: Porcupine Defense
porcupine-defense.description: Reinforce Nest of Bees with pointy Fire Lances which deal 10 damage back to melee attackers.

quilted-armor.name: Quilted Armor
quilted-armor.description: Utilizing local hunters' craftsmanship, Mohe Tribesman equip new armor which reduces bonus damage taken by -50%.

rain-of-fire.name: Rain of Fire
rain-of-fire.description: Keeps and Stone Wall Towers gain a grenade attack against nearby units that deals explosive damage. Enemies beware.

reinforced-axles.name: Reinforced Axles
reinforced-axles.description: Further increase the movement speed of siege engines by another +10%.

storm-lances.name: Storm Lances
storm-lances.description: Spearmen are equipped with Storm Lances, gaining an explosive ranged attack on a cooldown.

tower-shields.name: Tower Shields
tower-shields.description: Equipping tall tower shields grants Men-at-Arms +3 ranged armor.

flower-pagoda.name: Flower Pagoda
flower-pagoda.description:

Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

great-pasture.name: Great Pasture
great-pasture.description:
Acts as a War Stable and Grassland.

dragon-pavilion.name: Dragon Pavilion
dragon-pavilion.description:
Grants a free Meng'an Mouke Emplacement to all Town Centers and comes with a Meng'an Mouke Emplacement.

great-wall-bastion.description:

pagoda-forest.name: Pagoda Forest
pagoda-forest.description:
Spawns a Small Pagoda Forest nearby every 30 seconds up to a cap of 15. Each Small Pagoda Forest generates 20 Wood every 30 seconds and slows nearby enemy movement speed by 20%.
May garrison up to 3 Monks to cast a large cascading conversion, which grows larger for every Monk garrisoned.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

enclave-of-the-emperor.name: Enclave of the Emperor
enclave-of-the-emperor.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

kt.name: Knights Templar
kt.description: Founded to protect the meek and weary, the Knights Templar establish Commanderies throughout Europe to call on their allies. Fielding a spectacular array of heavy troops, the Templars lead the charge into battle with discipline and heart. Fortresses dot the carefully cultivated landscape, providing key defensive positions and safe haven to the pilgrims they protect.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Age Up at the Town Center by establishing a Commanderie.
Commanderies permanently unlock units and bonuses.
Pilgrims generate gold by traveling to Sacred Sites.
Build Fortresses in the Feudal Age.
Fortresses increase the range of nearby units and health of nearby Stone Walls.
Fortresses act as Landmarks, but can be fully destroyed.
Lumberjacks deposit wood automatically and gather faster with each Age.
Siege Workshops and Siege Engines cost less wood.
Trebuchets fire an additional projectile.

overview.title: Establish Commanderies
overview.description: Age Up at the Town Center by establishing one of three unique Commanderies. Each Commanderie permanently unlocks a unique unit and bonus.

overview.title: Frankish Defensive Schemes
overview.description:
Fortresses replace Keeps and are available in the Feudal Age.
Ranged units positioned near a Fortress have +15% increased attack range, and Stone Walls placed within the influence of a Fortress or the Templar Headquarters have +25% increased health and gain a default arrow.
Fortresses behave as Landmarks but can be fully destroyed.

overview.title: Pilgrimage
overview.description:
The Knights Templar cannot train Traders, instead they generate gold from successful pilgrimages. Upon reaching the Feudal Age, the Knights Templar may offer Safe Passage for Pilgrims to travel to a Sacred Site.
Every 60 seconds, a group of Pilgrims will travel from the Templar Headquarters to the selected Sacred Site, generating gold upon arrival based on the distance traveled. The size of the group is increased by 1 for each active Fortress up to a maximum of 10.
Sacred Sites and Relics are revealed at the start of the game.

overview.title: Coastal Harbors
overview.description: Build Harbors instead of Docks, which are more expensive but have increased health, a stronger emplacement, more garrison space for fishing ships, and increase the health of nearby ships.

overview.title: Landscape Preservation
overview.description:
Villagers automatically deposit wood without a Lumber Camp.
Wood is gathered +20%/+15%/+15% faster in each Age and 20% of the wood gathered is produced as additional food.

overview.title: Siege Experts
overview.description:
Trebuchets fire additional projectiles and can be deployed atop Fortresses with a unique emplacement.
Siege Workshops and Siege Engines cost -25% less wood.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Templar Brother: Knight replacement. More expensive than a regular Knight, but has additional health and damage.
Feudal Age
Knight Hospitaller Commanderie - Hospitaller Knight: Heavy Melee Infantry that can heal nearby friendly units.
Kingdom of France Commanderie - Chevalier Confrere: Heavy Cavalry that is cheaper than a regular Knight. Gains additional health for each nearby Heavy Cavalry unit.
Principality of Antioch Commanderie - Serjeant: Heavy Infantry with high melee armor. Throws axes which deal melee damage from range.
Castle Age
Angevin Empire Commanderie - Heavy Spearman: Armored Spearman that is stronger around Fortresses.
Republic of Genoa Commanderie - Genoese Crossbowman: Expensive Crossbowman that deals additional damage to melee infantry.
Kingdom of Castile Commanderie - Genitour: Mounted Javelineer that excels against ranged units.
Imperial Age
Kingdom of Poland Commanderie - Szlachta Cavalry: Elite Cavalry with exceptional ranged armor. Slows the attacks of enemies it damages and deals additional damage to light infantry.
Teutonic Order Commanderie - Teutonic Knight: Absurdly Powerful Heavy Infantry that gains power for each enemy felled in combat. Reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
Republic of Venice Commanderie - Condottiero: Fast infantry that costs only gold. Strong against Gunpowder units.
Venetian Galley: Large oared vessel with a long range forward mounted Trebuchet.
Venetian Trader: Expensive but fast moving trader. Max Build limit of 5.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses

stronghold-defensive-arrowslits.description: Upgrades all Varangian Strongholds with default arrowslit emplacements that deal 10 damage with 6 tiles weapon range.

grand-winery.name: Grand Winery
grand-winery.description: Acts as a Mill and Monastery. Villagers gather Food 35% faster when affected by its aura. Relics garrisoned generate 100 Silver instead of Gold.

imperial-hippodrome.name: Imperial Hippodrome
imperial-hippodrome.description:

cistern-of-the-first-hill.name: Cistern of the First Hill
cistern-of-the-first-hill.description:

golden-horn-tower.description:

foreign-engineering-company.name: Foreign Engineering Company
foreign-engineering-company.description: Allows production of Nest of Bees, Huihui Pao, and Royal Cannons for Silver.

palatine-school.name: Palatine School
palatine-school.description: Elite Cataphracts can be rapidly produced in batches at this Landmark for Silver.

cathedral-of-divine-wisdom.name: Cathedral of Divine Wisdom
cathedral-of-divine-wisdom.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

ma.name: Malians
ma.description: The Malian economy booms with options for gold and food production. Claiming gold deposits for their Pit Mines, they leverage that growth to produce unique infantry units that strike from stealth and hurl javelins at enemies.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Construct Pit Mines on Gold Veins to generate Gold without depleting the deposit.
Produce Cattle from Mills in the Dark Age (I). Malian Villagers harvest Food from Cattle faster than other civilizations or they can be garrisoned in a Cattle Ranch for Food over time.
Musofadi units can use the Activate Stealth ability to setup ambush attacks.
Five unique units with a different take on the counter system.
Veteran unit technologies are researched in half the time and cost.
Gold collected from Trader routes reduce the research time of future technologies.

Traders and Trade Ships that pass by Toll Outposts instantly provide bonus Gold based on the amount of Gold being carried. Does not generate any bonus tax if a toll outpost is built within range of another one.
Fishing Boats drop off 10% of their Food as Gold.

Transport Ships attack with javelins for each unit garrisoned.
Houses construct twice as fast, but are half cost and provide half the amount of Population.
Cannot harvest Boar

overview.title: Pit Mines
overview.description:
Wield a superior Gold economy and construct the Pit Mine over top of Gold Veins in the Dark Age (I) to generate Gold without depleting it. Villagers can mine Gold while the Pit Mine is active.
If the Gold Vein is completely exhausted, the Pit Mine will continue to extract Gold from the deposit.

overview.title: Influence - Mining Communities
overview.description:
Each House and Mining Camp constructed within the influence of Pit Mines increases its Gold generation.
Town Centers cost gold instead of stone to construct.

overview.title: Cattle & Ranches
overview.description: Produce Cattle from Mills in the Dark Age (I). Malian Villagers harvest Food from Cattle faster than other civilizations or they can be garrisoned in a Cattle Ranch for Food over time.

overview.title: Musofadi Pathfinder
overview.description: Musofadi Warrior and Musofadi Gunner unique units can use the Activate Stealth ability to sneak around and create ambush opportunities.

overview.title: Farari's Knowledge
overview.description: Veteran unit technologies unlocked in the Castle Age (III) are researched at half the time and cost.

overview.title: Toll Outposts
overview.description: Traders and Trade Ships that pass by Toll Outposts instantly provide bonus resources based on the current trade targets. Does not generate any bonus tax if a Toll Outpost is built within range of another one.

overview.title: Manuscript Trade
overview.description: Gold collected from completed Trader routes lower the research time of future technologies.

overview.title: Fish Processing
overview.description: Fishing Boats drop off 10% of their Food as Gold.

overview.title: Landing Parties
overview.description:
Movement speed of all ships increased when near their Docks.
Transport Ships attack with javelins for each unit garrisoned.

overview.title: Unique Units
list: Donso: Spearman replacement. Light melee infantry with increased health and melee armor that can periodically throw a javelin.
Warrior Scout: Light cavalry that can improve damage, move speed, health, and health regeneration.

local-knowledge.description: Musofadi Warriors and Musofadi Gunners gain +5 healing with each attack for 5 seconds after coming out of stealth.

precision-training.name: Precision Training

mansa-quarry.description: Generates 75 Gold per minute. Can be toggled to generate Stone instead.

saharan-trade-network.name: Saharan Trade Network
saharan-trade-network.description:
Acts as a Toll Outpost that comes with Defensive Javelin Emplacement researched. Unlocks Javelin Emplacement for Outposts.
All Traders and Trade Ships taxed will generate Food equal to the taxed Gold at this Landmark. All other Toll Outposts will generate 50% of taxed Gold as Food.

farimba-garrison.name: Farimba Garrison
farimba-garrison.description: Enlist one of three units to enhance your roster for free: the Mansa Musofadi, Mansa Javelineer, or Freeborn Warrior. The other two can be enlisted for an additional cost.

grand-fulani-corral.name: Grand Fulani Corral
grand-fulani-corral.description: Nearby cattle provide 16 Food per minute.

fort-of-the-huntress.name: Fort of the Huntress
fort-of-the-huntress.description:
Acts as a Keep that shoots poison arrows. Infantry units nearby the Landmark enter Stealth for 30 seconds.
Musofadi Warriors and Musofadi Gunners gain First Strike, dealing more damage when breaking Stealth with an attack.

griot-bara.name: Griot Bara
griot-bara.description: Begin a festival for 300 Gold, providing global enhancements to Food gather rates, unit production speeds, or damage of torches and siege attacks. One festival may be active at a time.

great-mosque.name: Great Mosque
great-mosque.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

mo.name: Mongols
mo.description: Masters of mobility and mounted warfare, the Mongols can easily relocate their camps. They gain economic benefits from setting up near Stone Outcroppings and from raiding enemy buildings. Enemies must deal with cavalry attacks from the opening moments of play.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Start with a packed Ger, maximum population limit, and no need for Houses.
All buildings can be packed up and redeployed to a new location.
Plunder +25 Food and Gold by igniting or destroying enemy buildings under construction.
Stables available in the Dark Age (I).
Horsemen train +25% faster.
Outposts increase move speed of nearby cavalry and Traders by +15%.
Double produce units or research advanced versions of technologies using Stone.
Silk Road: Traders generate +10% additional Food, Wood and Gold with 5/10/15 active Traders.

overview.title: Great Dominion
overview.description:
All buildings can be packed up and redeployed to a new location.
Forgo the need to build Houses and begin the game with maximum Population.

overview.title: Khanate
overview.description:
Field the mighty Khan in the Dark Age (I) to provide powerful bonuses to all nearby military units with Signal Arrows.
Khans and Scouts can deploy the Scouting Falcon ability to keep watch over the surrounding area.

overview.title: Expert Horsemen
overview.description: Construct Stables as early as the Dark Age and field Horsemen +25% faster.

overview.title: Nomadic Harvesters
overview.description: Construct Pastures instead of Farms to raise Sheep for Food — Pastures produce Sheep quicker when within the influence of an Ovoo.

overview.title: Raid Bounty
overview.description: Plunder enemy buildings for +25 Food and Gold when ignited or destroyed under construction.

overview.title: Augmented Transports
overview.description: Transport Ship landings are faster and more durable with +50% health and +15% move speed.

overview.title: Silk Road
overview.description:
Explore the Silk Road with Traders that receive extra resources from trades based on your total number of active Traders.
• 5+ Traders: +10% Food
• 10+ Traders: +10% Food, Wood
• 15+ Traders: +10% Food, Wood, Gold

overview.title: Influence
overview.description:
Construct the Ovoo over Stone outcroppings to generate influence and harvest Stone without the need for Villagers. Ovoos harvest +70, 100, 140, 170 Stone per minute after each age up.
Buildings within the influence of an Ovoo are able to double produce units or research improved versions of technologies using Stone.
