Increase Villagers' gathering rate for Food by 30%. Does not apply to hunted meat.
If Horticulture has already been researched, increase it by 20% instead.

lightweight-beams-improved.name: Lightweight Beams (Improved)
lightweight-beams-improved.description:
Increase Battering Ram attack speed by +30% and reduce their field construction time by -75%.
If Lightweight Beams has already been researched, increase attack speed by +10% and reduce field construction time by -25% instead.

military-academy-improved.name: Military Academy (Improved)
military-academy-improved.description:
Increase the production speed of military and transport units at buildings by 53%.
Does not affect religious or other support units.
If Military Academy has already been researched, increase production speed by 20% instead.

monastic-shrines.name: Monastic Shrines
monastic-shrines.description: Prayer Tents allow Improved Production within their influence even without an Ovoo.

pax-mongolica.name: Pax Mongolica
pax-mongolica.description: Add +300 health and +3 fire armor to all Outposts.

piety-improved.name: Piety (Improved)
piety-improved.description:
Increase all Shamans' health by +60.
If Piety has already been researched, increase it by +20 instead.

piracy.name: Piracy
piracy.description: Gain +25 Wood and +25 Gold when sinking an enemy ship.

raid-bounty.name: Raid Bounty
raid-bounty.description: Increase the raid income for igniting a building to +50 Food and Gold.

raid-bounty-improved.name: Raid Bounty (Improved)
raid-bounty-improved.description:
Increase the raid income for igniting a building to +75 Food and Gold.
If Raid Bounty has already been researched, increase the raid income for igniting a building by +25 Food and Gold.

roller-shutter-triggers-improved.name: Roller Shutter Triggers (Improved)
roller-shutter-triggers-improved.description:
Increases Springald attack speed by +35%, grants +10% Ranged Resistance, and increases health by +10.
If Roller Shutter Triggers has already been researched, increase attack speed by 10% and health by +10 instead.

siege-engineering-improved.name: Siege Engineering (Improved)
siege-engineering-improved.description: Melee and ranged infantry can construct Siege Towers and Battering Rams in the field. Improved Siege Engineering allows for the construction of Mangonels, Springalds and Trebuchets as well.

siege-works-improved.name: Siege Works (Improved)
siege-works-improved.description:
New carpentry techniques increase the health of siege engines by +30%.
If Siege Works has already been researched, increase their health by +10% instead.

siha-bow-limbs.name: Siha Bow Limbs
siha-bow-limbs.description: Increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +1.

siha-bow-limbs-improved.name: Siha Bow Limbs (Improved)
siha-bow-limbs-improved.description:
Increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +2.
If Siha Bow Limbs has already been researched, increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +1.

specialized-pick-improved.name: Specialized Pick (Improved)
specialized-pick-improved.description:
Increase Villagers' gathering rate for Gold by 35%.
If Specialized Pick has already been researched, increase it by 20% instead.

steppe-lancers.name: Steppe Lancers
steppe-lancers.description: Increase Keshik healing by +1 Health per attack and attack speed by +10%.

steppe-lancers-improved.name: Steppe Lancers (Improved)
steppe-lancers-improved.description:
Increase Keshik healing by +2 Health per attack and attack speed by +20%.
If Steppe Lancers has already been researched, increase Keshik healing by +1 Health per attack and attack speed by +10%.

stone-bounty.name: Stone Bounty
stone-bounty.description: Add +50 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.

stone-bounty-improved.name: Stone Bounty (Improved)
stone-bounty-improved.description:
Add +75 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.
If Stone Bounty has already been researched, add +25 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.

stone-commerce.name: Stone Commerce
stone-commerce.description: Traders supply +10% Stone to their trades.

stone-commerce-improved.name: Stone Commerce (Improved)
stone-commerce-improved.description:
Traders supply +20% Stone to their trades.
If Stone Commerce has already been researched, supply +10% Stone instead.

superior-mobility.name: Superior Mobility
superior-mobility.description: Packed buildings move and pack/unpack 50% faster.

superior-mobility-improved.name: Superior Mobility (Improved)
superior-mobility-improved.description:
Packed buildings move +70% faster and pack/unpack +50% faster.
If Superior Mobility has already been researched, increase speed by +20% instead.

survival-techniques-improved.name: Survival Techniques (Improved)
survival-techniques-improved.description:
Increase Villagers' hunted meat gather rate by +25%.
If Survival Techniques has already been researched, increase hunted meat gather rate by +10% instead.

textiles-improved.name: Textiles (Improved)
textiles-improved.description:
Increase Villagers' health by +50%.
If Textiles has already been researched, increase health by +100% instead.

tithe-barns-improved.name: Tithe Barns (Improved)
tithe-barns-improved.description:
Relics placed in a Prayer Tent provide an income of +60 Food, +60 Wood, and +15 Stone every minute.
If Tithe Barns has already been researched, increase the income of Food and Wood by +20 and Stone by +5 instead.

wheelbarrow-improved.name: Wheelbarrow (Improved)
wheelbarrow-improved.description:
Increase Villagers' resource carry capacity by +9 and movement speed by +15%.
If Wheelbarrow has already been researched, increase carry capacity by +4 instead.

whistling-arrows.name: Whistling Arrows
whistling-arrows.description: Increase the Khan's Signal Arrow duration by +5 seconds and range by +2 tiles.

whistling-arrows-improved.name: Whistling Arrows (Improved)
whistling-arrows-improved.description:
Increase the Khan's Signal Arrow duration by +7 seconds and range by +3 tiles.
If Whistling Arrows has already been researched, increase the Khan's Signal Arrow duration by +2 seconds and range by +1 tile.

yam-network.name: Yam Network
yam-network.description: Yam speed aura applies to all units instead of just Traders and cavalry units. Does not apply to siege engines.

yam-network-improved.name: Yam Network (Improved)
yam-network-improved.description:
Yam speed aura applies to all units instead of just Traders and cavalry units. Does not apply to siege engines.
Improved Yam Network allows Traders to regenerate 1 health every 2 seconds while in Yam's aura.

deer-stones.name: Deer Stones
deer-stones.description:
Deer Stones grant access to the Khan's Hunter at the Archery Range.
Instantly researches the Yam Network technology.

the-silver-tree.name: The Silver Tree
the-silver-tree.description: Acts as a Market. Production speed of Traders increased by +40% with a -40% reduced Gold cost.

kurultai.name: Kurultai
kurultai.description: Nearby units within its aura heal +1 health every 1 second and gain an additional +20% damage.

steppe-redoubt.name: Steppe Redoubt
steppe-redoubt.description: Acts as a Ger. Gold dropped off at this Landmark is increased by +50%.

khaganate-palace.name: Khaganate Palace
khaganate-palace.description: Automatically spawns diverse armies from across the Mongol Empire and its dominions.

the-white-stupa.name: The White Stupa
the-white-stupa.description:
Acts as an Ovoo and produces 240 Stone per minute without a Stone Outcropping.
Decreases the Stone cost of double unit production by -50%.

monument-of-the-great-khan.name: Monument of the Great Khan
monument-of-the-great-khan.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

od.name: Order of the Dragon
od.description: The Order of the Dragon is established by handpicked wealthy elites to crush hostile empires. Investing large amounts of resources into training only a few exceptional warriors, the Order succeeds in raising an elite army unlike any other.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Villagers carry +40% more resources, gather +27% faster, and construct and repair buildings +20% faster.
Infantry and cavalry units are much stronger, but also more expensive to produce and take twice the population
Place Relics in Outposts, Stone Towers and Keeps for defensive and economic bonuses.
Relics placed in Docks increase ship attack speed by +5% per Relic (Max +20%).
Emplacements are -20% cheaper. Outpost sight range increased by +20%.
Buildings within influence of a Town Center gain the Emergency Repairs ability which can be activated to repair the building.

overview.title: Efficient Villagers
overview.description: Villagers gather 27% quicker, construct and repair buildings 20% faster, but cost 20% more Food to produce.

overview.title: Religious Zeal
overview.description:
Demonstrate the might of the empire by placing Relics in Outposts, Towers, and Keeps - increasing their armor by +25%, damage by +25%, range by +25%, and line of sight by +20%.
Relics placed in Docks increase ship attack speed by +5% per Relic (Max +25%).
Relics placed in buildings generate +80 Gold per minute.

overview.title: Elite Equipment
overview.description: Research technologies like Heavy Torches, Scale Armor, and War Horses to further strengthen the might of the Order.

overview.title: Emplacement Architecture
overview.description: All emplacement technologies are -20% cheaper. Outpost sight range increased by +20%.

overview.title: Pushcarts
overview.description: Villagers carry +40% more resources than other civilizations.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Buildings constructed within the influence of a Town Center gain the Emergency Repairs ability which can be activated to repair the building for +150 health every second for 20 seconds.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description: The elite infantry and cavalry units of the Order - such as the Gilded Man-at-Arms, the Gilded Knight and others - have nearly twice the health of regular units and deal significantly more damage. However, they are much more costly to train and take up double the population space.

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

carrack.name: Carrack
carrack.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with broadside cannons.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Low movement speed

counterweight-trebuchet.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
counterweight-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

culverin.name: Culverin
culverin.description:
Long-range mobile cannon with bonus vs buildings.
+ Effective against Defenses
+ Does not require setup to fire

demolition-ship.name: Demolition Ship
demolition-ship.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

fishing-boat.name: Fishing Boat
fishing-boat.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.
+ Can repair
- No combat

galley.name: Galley
galley.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

gilded-archer.name: Gilded Archer
gilded-archer.description:
Ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets and increased fire rate and longer weapon range than standard Archers.
+ Increased weapon range
+ Faster attack speed
- Weak against armored targets
- Countered by Horsemen

gilded-crossbowman.name: Gilded Crossbowman
gilded-crossbowman.description:
Crossbowmen with increased range and exceptionally high damage against heavy units.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
+ Long range
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

gilded-handcannoneer.name: Gilded Handcannoneer
gilded-handcannoneer.description:
More powerful all-purpose ranged infantry with increased attack speed.
+ High damage
+ Increased attack speed
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

gilded-horseman.name: Gilded Horseman
gilded-horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

gilded-knight.name: Gilded Knight
gilded-knight.description:
Expensive cavalry with a powerful charge.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

gilded-landsknecht.name: Gilded Landsknecht
gilded-landsknecht.description:
Brave unarmored infantry with an enormous two-handed sword, effective in mixed armies.
+ Melee attack deals area damage
- Low health
- Countered by Archers

gilded-man-at-arms.name: Early Gilded Man-at-Arms
gilded-man-at-arms.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

gilded-spearman.name: Gilded Spearman
gilded-spearman.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

gilded-villager.name: Gilded Villager
gilded-villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units. Gathers resources 27% quicker and builds and repairs 20% faster than regular Villagers.
- Weak in combat

hulk.name: Hulk
hulk.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

prelate.name: Prelate
prelate.description:
Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites starting in the Castle Age (III).
+ Heals friendly units
- Low health

scout.name: Scout
scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

transport-ship.name: Transport Ship
transport-ship.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

bodkin-bolts.name: Bodkin Bolts
bodkin-bolts.description: Gilded Crossbowmen deal +20 damage against Siege units.

fire-stations.name: Fire Stations
fire-stations.description: Military Ships regenerate +1 health every 2 seconds when out of combat.

golden-cuirass.name: Golden Cuirass
golden-cuirass.description: Gilded Men-at-Arms who fall below 20% health take -20% damage.

heavy-torches.name: Heavy Torches
heavy-torches.description: Gilded Spearman torches deal area of effect damage.

inspired-warriors.name: Inspired Warriors
inspired-warriors.description: Prelates increase their move speed by 10% and can inspire groups of military units, improving their armor by +1, and damage by +10%.

reinforced-defenses.name: Reinforced Defenses
reinforced-defenses.description: Increase the health of walls, towers, and gates by +25%.

scale-armor.name: Scale Armor
scale-armor.description: Increase the ranged armor of Gilded Archers by +3.

war-horses.name: War Horses
war-horses.description: Gilded Knights take -25% damage while charging.

zornhau.name: Zornhau
zornhau.description:
Gilded Landsknecht equip a halberd weapon that wounds enemies. When struck by this weapon, a unit will bleed for 2 damage every second. Lasts 10 seconds.
Any healing effect will remove the bleed.

aachen-chapel.name: Aachen Chapel
aachen-chapel.description:
Inspires all Villagers in a large radius and increases their gather rate by +15%. 
Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.

meinwerk-palace.name: Meinwerk Palace
meinwerk-palace.description: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.

burgrave-palace.name: Burgrave Palace
burgrave-palace.description: Acts as a Barracks that produces units 35% faster and 35% cheaper. Researches technologies 35% faster.

regnitz-cathedral.name: Regnitz Cathedral
regnitz-cathedral.description: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.

elzbach-palace.name: Elzbach Palace
elzbach-palace.description: Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage.

palace-of-swabia.name: Palace of Swabia
palace-of-swabia.description:
Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost.
Cost to build this Landmark is reduced by -10%.

great-palace-of-flensburg.name: Great Palace of Flensburg
great-palace-of-flensburg.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

ot.name: Ottomans
ot.description: The Ottoman Army can expand to dominate the battlefield, supported by Military Schools that are able to continuously produce units to swell the ranks of their formations. Supporting those formations, the Mehter war drums signal the highly trained troops to take situational advantage.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Training units and advancing the ages grant experience towards Vizier Points, the higher cost of the action, the more experience is earned. Gain up to five Vizier Points and spend them to unlock powerful unique Ottoman bonuses.
Military Schools can produce units continuously at no cost.
Influence from Blacksmiths and Universities provide increased military unit production speeds after each age up.
Military and technology buildings are cheaper.
Janissary handcannoneer unit available in the Castle Age (III). Able to repair siege engines.
Mehter war drummer enhances the attack and defenses of nearby military units.
Field the Great Bombard siege engine with longer range and area damage.
Produce the Grand Galley ship that can convert into a floating Military School.
Movement speed of Trade Ships and Transport Ships increased.
Cannot harvest Boar.

overview.title: Military School Training
overview.description: Construct the Military School building that can produce a specific type of unit continuously at no cost, however they are produced at a slower rate.

overview.title: Imperial Council
overview.description: Training units and advancing through the ages will grant experience towards Vizier Points, the higher cost of the action, the more experience earned. Gain up to five Vizier Points and spend them to unlock powerful unique Ottoman bonuses.

overview.title: Military Inducement
overview.description: Train, upgrade, and assemble an army with cheaper military and technology buildings.

overview.title: Shipping Routes
overview.description: Movement speed of Trade Ships, Fishing Boats, and Transport Ships increased.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Military production buildings constructed within the influence of a Blacksmith or University gain increased production speed with each age up.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Sipahi: Horseman replacement. Activate the Fortitude ability to attack faster but receive more damage from melee weapons.
Mehter: Mounted war drummer that provides military enhancements to nearby units when toggling the War Drums ability.
• Attack Drums: Increased attack speed.
• Melee Defense Drums: Increased melee armor.
• Ranged Defense Drums: Increased ranged armor.
Janissary: Powerful handcannoneer that can repair siege engines and deal bonus damage to cavalry.
Grand Galley: Large war galley that can convert into a floating Military School.
Great Bombard: Largest gunpowder siege engine that can be fielded. Has long range and area damage attack.
Akinji: Long-ranged cavalry which fires two arrows in quick succession. Must be unlocked through the Imperial Council.

Highly mobile long ranged cavalry which fires two arrows in quick succession. 
+ High mobility
- Weak vs ranged units

- Countered by Horsemen

+ Very long range
- Lower damage

janissary.description:
Powerful infantry effective against cavalry and can repair siege engines.

- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

- Short range
- Low ranged armor

advanced-academy.name: Advanced Academy
advanced-academy.description: Increases military production speed by +25% and outfits Military Schools with the ability to train Lancers and Janissaries.

anatolian-hills.name: Anatolian Hills
anatolian-hills.description: Spawn 12 sheep at the Landmark Town Center and increase Villager mining speed by +15%.

field-work.name: Field Work
field-work.description: Spawn 2 Imams at the Landmark Town Center. Imams area heal nearby units for 0.5 health every second. Increases to 0.8 health in Feudal Age, 2 health in Castle Age, and 3 health in Imperial Age.

imperial-fleet.name: Imperial Fleet
imperial-fleet.description: Increase the production speed of Gunpowder Ships by 25% and their movement speed by 25%.

janissary-company.name: Janissary Company
janissary-company.description: Spawn 2 Janissaries for each of your Landmark Town Center and Military Schools at the Landmark Town Center.

mehter-drums.name: Mehter Drums
mehter-drums.description: Spawn 2 Mehter at the Landmark Town Center. Mehters increase move speed to units in the same formation by +15%.

military-campus.name: Military Campus
military-campus.description: Increase Military Schools that can be built by +1.

siege-crews.name: Siege Crews
siege-crews.description: Allows all siege engines to be garrisoned by infantry. While garrisoned, attack and setup speed is increased by +25%.

trade-bags.name: Trade Bags
trade-bags.description: Increase the amount of Gold Traders collect and Income from the Sultanhani Trade Network by +40%.

sultanhani-trade-network.name: Sultanhani Trade Network
sultanhani-trade-network.description: Acts as a Market. Comes with 3 Traders garrisoned and generates +28 Gold per minute for each one. Up to 10 Traders can be garrisoned.

twin-minaret-medrese.name: Twin Minaret Medrese
twin-minaret-medrese.description: Acts as a Mill. Grows 4 Berry Bushes which can be harvested +50% faster. Berry Bushes are regrown after 120 seconds if depleted.

istanbul-imperial-palace.name: Istanbul Imperial Palace
istanbul-imperial-palace.description: Doubles Imperial Council experience gained globally and increases the Vizier Point limit by +4.

mehmed-imperial-armory.name: Mehmed Imperial Armory
mehmed-imperial-armory.description: Produces siege engines for free but with a longer train time.

istanbul-observatory.name: Istanbul Observatory
istanbul-observatory.description: Acts as a University. Improves the influence provided by the University and Blacksmith and production speed of the Grand Galley to +85%.

sea-gate-castle.name: Sea Gate Castle
sea-gate-castle.description:
Acts as a Keep with a free Great Bombard emplacement. Defensive Strucutures deal 20% more damage.
All Keeps gain an aura that increases Trader and Trade Ship movement speed by +30% and armor by +8.

azure-mosque.name: Azure Mosque
azure-mosque.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

ru.name: Rus
ru.description: The Rus derive great benefit from the countryside. They are able to gather resources more readily from hunting and forestry and can field strong combat units. Enemies face strong early game fortifications and a diverse economy that cannot easily be disrupted.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Construct Fortified Palisade Walls with +100% health.
Construct Wooden Fortresses — improved Outposts with +100% health and +3 garrison slots.
Construct Hunting Cabins — improved Mills that produce Scouts and generate Gold from nearby forests.
Gathering from animals earns a bounty of Gold — increased bounty provides economic bonuses to Villagers and Hunting Cabins.
Early Knight available in the Feudal Age (II).
Lodya ship can convert into any type of ship for a cost.
Fishing Ships don't have to return to a dock to drop off Food.

overview.title: Woodland Federation
overview.description:
Fortify the countryside with Wooden Fortresses that replace Outposts — comes with +100% health and +3 garrison slots.
Construct the Fortified Palisade Wall — comes with +100% health and faster build time.

overview.title: Hunter Princes
overview.description: Live off the land with Scouts trained from Hunting Cabins. Hunting Cabins provide the benefits of a standard Mill but with the ability to see into Stealth Forests and generate Gold based on the number of nearby trees.

overview.title: Druzhina Retinue
overview.description: Field the Early Knight in the Feudal Age (II).

overview.title: Lodya Reconstitution
overview.description:
Lodya ship can convert into any type of ship for a cost.
Lodya Fishing Ships process Food directly on the vessel — forgoing the need to return to Docks to drop off Food.

overview.title: Bounty Rewards
overview.description:
Gathering from animals earns a bounty of Gold and reaching certain thresholds of total bounty provides economic bonuses to Villagers and Hunting Cabins.
100 Bounty
• +10% Food gather rate
• Hunting Cabins generate 10% more Gold
400 Bounty
• +15% Food gather rate
• Hunting Cabins generate 25% more Gold
1000 Bounty
• +20% Food gather rate
• Hunting Cabins generate 40% more Gold

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Oversee clear-cutting initiatives — Villagers drop off +20% more Wood when Lumber Camps and Town Centers are within a Wooden Fortress's influence.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Warrior Monk: Religious light cavalry unit that inspires nearby units when in combat, providing +1 armor and +2 damage.
Horse Archer: Light ranged cavalry with high mobility and damage.
Streltsy: Handcannoneer which gets stronger when stationary and has a high damage melee attack.
Lodya ships: Can be converted into any type of ship.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description:
Cheap ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ High rate of fire
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

bombard.name: Bombard
bombard.description:
Intimidating siege gun excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ High damage
- Must be set up to fire

counterweight-trebuchet.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
counterweight-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

horse-archer.name: Horse Archer
horse-archer.description:
Highly mobile ranged cavalry effective against slower melee units.
+ High mobility
- Weak vs ranged units

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

knight.name: Early Knight
knight.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and melee armor. Effective against melee units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

lodya-attack-ship.name: Lodya Attack Ship
lodya-attack-ship.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

lodya-demolition-ship.name: Lodya Demolition Ship
lodya-demolition-ship.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
+ The Lodya can be converted to any other type of ship
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

lodya-fishing-boat.name: Lodya Fishing Boat
lodya-fishing-boat.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Does not require a Dock to drop off gathered Food and gathers faster than a regular Fishing Boat.
- No combat
The Lodya Fishing Boat can be converted to any other type of ship.

lodya-galley.name: Lodya Galley
lodya-galley.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

lodya-trade-ship.name: Lodya Trade Ship
lodya-trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
The Lodya can be converted to any other type of ship.

lodya-transport-ship.name: Lodya Transport Ship
lodya-transport-ship.description:
Can be garrisoned by any unit and uses their sight range. Allows garrisoned units to be transport across water.
The Lodya can be converted to any other type of ship.

man-at-arms.name: Man-at-Arms
man-at-arms.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

militia-halberdier.name: Militia Halberdier
militia-halberdier.description:
Light melee infantry equipped with a polearm.
+ Fast moving
- Countered by Archers
- Can't garrison
- Loses life over time

scout.name: Scout
scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

streltsy.name: Streltsy
streltsy.description:
Most powerful ranged infantry with reasonable melee capabilities. Increased attack speed while stationary.
+ High damage
+ Lower cost than Handcannoneer
- Slow movement speed

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat

warrior-monk.name: Warrior Monk
warrior-monk.description:
Military-minded support unit that improves combat capabilities of nearby units after it attacks. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
+ High utility in large armies
- Low damage

adaptable-hulls.name: Adaptable Hulls
adaptable-hulls.description: Converting between Lodya Ship types is 50% faster and no longer has a cost penalty.

banded-arms.name: Banded Arms
banded-arms.description: Increase the range of Springalds by +1 tiles.

boyars-fortitude.name: Boyar's Fortitude
boyars-fortitude.description: Increase the health of Rus cavalry by +25.

castle-turret.name: Castle Turret
castle-turret.description: Increase the damage of arrows fired from this Wooden Fortress by +2.

castle-watch.name: Castle Watch
castle-watch.description: Increase the sight range of this Wooden Fortress by 6 tiles.

divine-light.name: Divine Light
divine-light.description: Increase the duration of Saint's Blessing by +10 seconds.

fervor.name: Fervor
fervor.description: Improve the range of Saint's Blessing by +5 tiles and the damage granted by Saint's Blessing by +1.

fine-tuned-guns.name: Fine Tuned Guns
fine-tuned-guns.description: Increase damage of Bombards by +20%. Bombards gain +50 damage vs Infantry.

knight-poleaxes.name: Knight Poleaxes
knight-poleaxes.description: Knights equip a poleax, increasing their melee damage by +4.

mounted-training.name: Mounted Training
mounted-training.description:
Increase weapon range of Horse Archers by +1 and unlock the Gallop ability.
Gallop: Activate to move at maximum speed with +2 tile weapon range for 8 seconds.

saints-veneration.name: Saint's Veneration
saints-veneration.description: Increase the health of Warrior Monks by +100.

siege-crew-training.name: Siege Crew Training
siege-crew-training.description: Setup and teardown speed of Mangonels, Trebuchets, and Bombards is instant.

wandering-town.name: Wandering Town
wandering-town.description: Ram damage increased by +25%. Rams heal 2 health every 1 second.

kremlin.name: Kremlin
kremlin.description:
Acts as a Wooden Fortress that comes with Arrowslits, Castle Turret, and Castle Watch technologies.
Can Levy Militia every 80 seconds to the Capital Town Center. The number of Militia levied increases upon reaching the Castle Age.

the-golden-gate.name: The Golden Gate
the-golden-gate.description: Allows the exchange of resources at a favorable rate. Generates an additional exchange every 50 seconds.

abbey-of-the-trinity.name: Abbey of the Trinity
abbey-of-the-trinity.description: Acts as a Monastery. Reduces the cost of Warrior Monks by -50% and contains unique religious technologies.

high-trade-house.name: High Trade House
high-trade-house.description:
Generates Gold like a Hunting Cabin with the value increased by +400%, without claiming any trees. Spawns a Huntable Deer every 60 seconds.
Villagers can drop off Food at this building.

high-armory.name: High Armory
high-armory.description: Decrease the cost of siege engines in nearby Siege Workshops by -20%. Contains unique siege engine technologies.

spasskaya-tower.name: Spasskaya Tower
spasskaya-tower.description:
Acts as a Keep with all weapon emplacements and increased health.
Unlocks the building of Stone Walls, Stone Gates, and Stone Wall Towers.

cathedral-of-the-tsar.name: Cathedral of the Tsar
cathedral-of-the-tsar.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

sco.name: Scots
sco.description: The Scots field resilient infantry that excel at ambushing enemies from stealth. Tower Houses and Keeps protect their communities and precious cattle from raiders across the countryside. Muster reinforcements quickly at the Mustering Hall and research powerful Highland or Lowland technologies and secure the Kingdom of Scotland.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Ghillies can stealth in the open.
Infantry have vision and movement speed bonuses while in Stealth Forests.
Tower Houses replace Outposts, produce Highland Cattle, and increase population.
Highland Cattle graze at Berry Bushes to gather Food over time.
Highland Landmarks increase Highland Cattle capacity.
Muster units quickly at the Mustering Hall from Feudal Age (II).
Research powerful technologies from the Lowlands and Highlands at the Mustering Hall.
Kirkmen can create Fishponds to gather Gold and increase the gather rates of nearby workers.
Lowland Landmarks increase the Fishpond build limit.
Destroyed Keeps can be repaired for a limited time before being completely destroyed.
Destroyed Keeps create a scorched-earth effect that reduces the combat effectiveness of nearby enemies.
Naval arrowslits are 50% cheaper.

overview.title: Noble Houses
overview.description: Tower Houses replace Outposts, produce Highland Cattle, Ghillies, and increase population.

overview.title: Highland Wealth
overview.description: Protect Highland Cattle while they graze at Berry Bushes, providing Food over time as they eat. Cattle capacity increases with each Highland Landmark built.

overview.title: Highland Ambush
overview.description: Infantry have deep knowledge and connection to their lands and fight with advantage in and around Stealth Forests. No vision penalties while in Stealth Forests and movement speed is increased when Highland Ambush is active.

overview.title: Scottish Schiltron
overview.description: Gallowglass can brace for cavalry charges by default, and Men-at-Arms can brace after Lochaber Axes is researched.

overview.title: Lowlands and Highlands
overview.description: Choose between a Highland or a Lowland Landmark each time when aging up. The Mustering Hall holds unique technologies from these lands. As Landmarks are constructed from a region, the associated technologies halve in cost for its support.

overview.title: Answer the Call
overview.description: Muster warriors quickly at the Mustering Hall from the Feudal Age (II).

overview.title: Monastic Fishponds
overview.description: Create harvestable Fishponds with a Kirkman to gather Gold. Workers near active Fishponds receive increased gather rates. Landmarks from the Lowlands increase the maximum Fishpond count.

overview.title: Castle Ruins
overview.description: Upon destruction, Keeps adopt scorched earth tactics and sabotage the immediate area for a duration. If any enemies are within the area of sabotage their combat effectiveness is temporarily reduced. During this time Keeps become Keep Ruins and can be saved from total destruction if repaired. Keep Ruins can be fully restored for up to maximum of 600 Stone after which repairing Keep Ruins becomes free.

overview.title: Loch Defensive Network
overview.description: Dock defensive arrowslits are 50% cheaper.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description:
Construct military buildings around the Mustering Hall to increase its level to improve the efficiency of mustering warriors.
Tier 1: Unlocks mustering of Highland Archers. Adds a muster charge. 
Tier 2: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge.
Tier 3: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge. Mustered warrior health is increased.

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

border-reiver.name: Border Reiver
border-reiver.description:
Fast moving light cavalry that excel at countering ranged cavalry and raiding.
+ Uses Torches when attacking buildings
+ Bonus damage to ranged cavalry
- Low Health
- Countered by Horseman and Archers

carrack.name: Carrack
carrack.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with broadside cannons.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Low movement speed

cateran.name: Cateran
cateran.description:
Swift light melee infantry with bonus damage against workers and buildings.
+ Fast move speed
+ Stronger torch
- Countered by Archers, Knights, Lancers

counterweight-trebuchet.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
counterweight-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

culverin.name: Culverin
culverin.description:
Long-range mobile cannon with bonus vs buildings.
+ Effective against Defenses
+ Does not require setup to fire

demolition-ship.name: Demolition Ship
demolition-ship.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

fishing-boat.name: Fishing Boat
fishing-boat.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.
+ Can repair
- No combat

galley.name: Galley
galley.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

gallowglass.name: Gallowglass
gallowglass.description:
Heavy melee infantry equipped with a two-handed claymore, effective in mixed armies.
+ Melee attack deals area damage
+ Braces for cavalry charges
- Slow attack speed
- Countered by Crossbows, Knights

highland-archer.name: Highland Archer
highland-archer.description:
Ranged infantry with reduced weapon range for extra damage. Great vs. unarmored targets.
+ Damage
+ High rate of fire
- Weapon range
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

highland-cattle.name: Highland Cattle
highland-cattle.description:
Highland Cattle sustain themselves at Berry Bushes for Food. While eating they produce Food at a rate of 30 per minute.
They begin with a capacity of 9, and that increases by 4 with every Highland Landmark built.

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

hulk.name: Hulk
hulk.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

kirkman.name: Kirkman
kirkman.description:
Support unit that can establish and gather from Fishponds. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed

knight.name: Knight
knight.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and melee armor. Effective against melee units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

man-at-arms.name: Early Man-at-Arms
man-at-arms.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

pikeman.name: Pikeman
pikeman.description:
Infantry equipped with a long pike, best used against mounted units.
+ Increased weapon range
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Countered by Archers

ribauldequin.name: Ribauldequin
ribauldequin.description:
Five-barreled gunpowder weapon effective against massed units. Deals little damage to buildings.
+ Can hit multiple targets in a single volley
- Short range
- Low ranged armor

scout.name: Ghillie
scout.description:
Expert of camouflage, scouting, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Open area Stealth ability
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

tacksman.name: Tacksman
tacksman.description:
Powerful all-purpose ranged infantry that enhances nearby Highland Warrior damage.
+ High damage
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

transport-ship.name: Transport Ship
transport-ship.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat

barmkins.name: Barmkins
barmkins.description: Tower Houses are granted lands to construct Barmkins, offering 4 additional garrison slots for Highland Cattle in the event of raids.

basket-hilted-broadswords.name: Basket-hilted Broadswords
basket-hilted-broadswords.description: Caterans wield Scottish broadswords and dirks, increasing attack speed by 25% and melee armor by 2.

birlinn-crews.name: Birlinn Crews
birlinn-crews.description: Masters of oar and sail, Galleys gain 15% movement speed and 20% attack speed.

caterans-trail.name: Cateran's Trail
caterans-trail.description: Cateran increases the movement speed of infantry by 15%. Infantry heal for 1 health per second in Stealth Forests while out of combat.

clan-traditions.name: Clan Traditions
clan-traditions.description: Melee infantry damage is increased by 15%. Highland Ambush bonus duration is increased by 10 seconds.

fermtouns-and-pastures.name: Fermtouns and Pastures
fermtouns-and-pastures.description: Villagers gather from Farms 20% faster and Highland Cattle gather from Berry Bushes 20% faster.

feuds-aside.name: Feuds Aside
feuds-aside.description: The Highlands share their gunpowder stores among all regions, increasing the attack speed of Tacksmen, Border Reivers, and gunpowder siege engines by 20%

fortified-tower-houses.name: Fortified Tower Houses
fortified-tower-houses.description: All Tower Houses fortify themselves with stone, increasing their fire armor by 5.

lions-duty.name: Lion's Duty
lions-duty.description: Infantry gain 1 armor when near Landmarks, Keeps, Tower Houses, and Stone Wall Towers.

lochaber-axes.name: Lochaber Axes
lochaber-axes.description: Men-at-Arms equip Lochaber Axes, gaining 3 damage and 4 anti-cavalry damage. Men-at-Arms brace against cavalry charges.

muster-border-reivers.name: Muster Border Reivers
muster-border-reivers.description: Call upon Border Reivers and recruit 12 to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-cateran.name: Muster Cateran
muster-cateran.description: Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 8 Caterans to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-gallowglass.name: Muster Gallowglass
muster-gallowglass.description: Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 7 Gallowglass to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-highland-archers.name: Muster Highland Archers
muster-highland-archers.description: Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 9 Highland Archers to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-mangonels.name: Muster Mangonels
muster-mangonels.description: Call upon landholding vassals to recruit 2 Mangonels to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-pikemen.name: Muster Pikemen
muster-pikemen.description: Call upon landholding vassals to recruit 8 Pikemen to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

muster-royal-navy.name: Muster Royal Navy
muster-royal-navy.description: The King calls upon royal shipyards to send reinforcements to the Three Loch Lookout, recruiting 4 Galleys, 4 Hulks, and 3 Carracks. Can only be used once.

muster-tacksmen.name: Muster Tacksmen
muster-tacksmen.description: Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 7 Tacksmen to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once.

snaphance-locks.name: Snaphance Locks
snaphance-locks.description: With new snaphance mechanisms, Tacksmen and Border Reivers gain +5 damage against melee infantry, and gain a brief increase to their movement speed after firing their weapon.

stew-ponds.name: Stew Ponds
stew-ponds.description: Increases Fishpond capacity by 1 and increases gather rates of workers near Fishponds from 10% to 20%. Instantly spawns a free Kirkman.

wallaces-rally.name: Wallace's Rally
wallaces-rally.description: Wallace's legacy continues to inspire his people, increasing infantry production speed by 50%. Infantry rally with 25% increased movement speed while out of combat for 25 seconds.

we-stand-alone.name: We Stand Alone
we-stand-alone.description: Embrace the master masonry of the Lowlands. All building health is increased by 30%, and emplacement attack speeds are increased by 50%. Masons automatically repair buildings whenever they're damaged for 3 health per second.

abbey-of-the-isles.name: Abbey of the Isles
abbey-of-the-isles.description: Contains a Saint's Relic to provide area healing that increases in effectiveness for each Age. The relic can be moved to military and technology buildings to provide 135% increased research and production speed in addition to area healing. Cannot be moved to other Landmarks or buildings with defenses.

stone-of-destiny.name: Stone of Destiny
stone-of-destiny.description: Buildings constructed around the Stone of Destiny have 30% of their construction cost rebated as Gold. Does not apply to Landmarks. Grants early access to Kirkman that can create Fishponds.

snowdoun-gate.name: Snowdoun Gate
snowdoun-gate.description:
Produces toggled infantry for free with a value of 190 resources per minute. 
Technologies researched at the Mustering Hall increase infantry production speed at this Landmark by 15%. When enemies are nearby, infantry hasten their deployment and gain an additional 15% production speed.

tower-of-skye.name: Tower of Skye
tower-of-skye.description: Acts as a Tower House equipped with arrowslits and a springald emplacement. Creates a local Stealth Forest and increases infantry damage by 15% while in Stealth Forests. Tower Houses unlock the ability to create additional Stealth Forests. Galleys unlock the Fairy's Chosen ability.

dhun-eideann.name: Dhùn Èideann
dhun-eideann.description: Equipped with the "Seven Sisters" cannons to defend the area. Produces gunpowder siege engines for 100 less Gold. Gunpowder siege weapons gain 1 tile range.

three-loch-lookout.name: Three Loch Lookout
three-loch-lookout.description: Has a large line of sight and adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout. The number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%. Comes with the option to muster a navy if constructed adjacent to water.

guardian-of-scotland.name: Guardian of Scotland
guardian-of-scotland.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

sen.name: Sengoku Daimyo
sen.description: The Sengoku Jidai was an era of shifting alliances and ceaseless warfare. Three rival clans can be supported to gain powerful advantages to your ranged infantry, melee infantry or cavalry. Even in the midst of war there was time for celebration; the Matsuri festival is the heart of commerce and trade providing powerful bonuses to their economy.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Daimyo Estates can be dedicated to a clan to provide bonuses to melee infantry, cavalry or ranged infantry.
Farmhouses are Food drop-off sites in addition to providing Population.
The Matsuri is a unique early Market that can recruit Yatai which can passively gather food from nearby Food sources.
Survival Techniques researched by default.
Forges are Gold and Stone drop-off sites in addition to containing military upgrades.
Gold deposited by Villagers generates bonus Stone and vice versa.
Extra melee damage upgrade accessible in the Dark Age (I).
Ikko-ikki are combat monks that can be recruited from Buddhist Monasteries that heal while attacking.
Keeps come equipped with Rocket Emplacements and increased health in the Imperial Age (IV).
Fishing Boats are cheaper to produce.
The location of all Deer and Boar are revealed on the map.

overview.title: Daimyo Estate

overview.title: Völur
overview.description: Völur are support units that can travel between Longhouses, boosting the production of Bee Skeps and Farmsteads for a duration. The Völur can also be sacrificed to establish a Sacred Grove on Relics, which passively recruits Berserkers and has an aura that increases the armor of nearby units.

overview.title: Bondi
overview.description: Bondi are unique spearmen that have increased health and armor. When Bondi are near each other, they gain a Shield Wall buff temporarily increasing their health.

overview.title: Berserker
overview.description: The Berserker is a unique light armor unit that has high damage, fast movement speed, and is armed with two axes. Berserkergang is triggered at low health, which regenerates health and increases damage.

overview.title: Living Off The Land
overview.description: Military infantry can heal themselves by gathering Food from deposits such as Berry Bushes, Deer or Boar.

overview.title: Longship and Drakkar
overview.description: The Longship is a unique archer ship that also acts as a transport, each loaded unit increases the arrows fired and increases health. The Drakkar replaces the Springald Ship and can throw nets on enemy ships to slow them down.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Construct Longhouses within the Dock's influence to reduce the cost of ships in all Docks by 4% for each Longhouse up to a maximum of 16%.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description:
Cheap ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ High rate of fire
- Weak against high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description:
Fast and light infantry that have good damage and are effective against light units.
+ High movement
+ When health is below 25% they will heal and get increased damage
- Low Armor
- Countered by Archers

bombard.name: Bombard
bombard.description:
Intimidating siege gun excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ High damage
- Must be set up to fire

bondi.name: Bondi
bondi.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units with increased health and armor. While they are near other Bondi they form a shield wall giving them bonus health.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- More expensive
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

counterweight-trebuchet.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
counterweight-trebuchet.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

demolition-ship.name: Demolition Ship
demolition-ship.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

drakkar.name: Drakkar
drakkar.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of axe throwers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Can slow enemy ships with nets

fishing-knarr.name: Fishing Knarr
fishing-knarr.description: Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish and that is also able to transport a small number of land units across water. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.

handcannoneer.name: Handcannoneer
handcannoneer.description:
Powerful all-purpose ranged infantry.
+ High damage
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

hirdman.name: Early Hirdman
hirdman.description:
Tough infantry with increased damage and armor.
+ High armor
- More expensive
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

jylland-knight.name: Jylland Knight
jylland-knight.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and melee armor. Effective against melee units. Lower cost but with reduced damage and health. 
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
+ Grants 10 Gold on death
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

longship.name: Longship
longship.description:
Oared war vessel armed with archers that is also able to transport land units across water.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Each non-Villager loaded increases health by +30 and +1 arrow fired.

mangonel.name: Mangonel
mangonel.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

monk.name: Monk
monk.description:
Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed

scout.name: Scout
scout.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

shield-maiden.name: Shield Maiden
shield-maiden.description:
Heavy ranged unit that has +2 damage and +25% move speed when near allied buildings. 
+ High armor
+ High health
+ Provides +2 armor to nearby Villagers
- Countered by Horsemen

sk-ne-crossbowmen.name: Skåne Crossbowmen
sk-ne-crossbowmen.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets. Lower cost but with reduced damage and health. 
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

springald.name: Springald
springald.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

trade-ship.name: Trade Ship
trade-ship.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

trader.name: Trader
trader.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
- Weak in combat

volur.name: Völur
volur.description:
Support unit with no combat capability that can be sacrificed to establish a Sacred Grove on a Relic or can automatically move between Longhouses boosting their production.
- Weak to all attacks
- Slow movement speed

warship.name: Warship
warship.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with broadside cannons.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Low movement speed

bee-skeps.name: Bee Skeps
bee-skeps.description:
Generates 50 Gold per minute. Increases Longhouse health by 500.
Limited to 6 Bee Skep upgraded Longhouses.

bondi-forester.name: Bondi Forester
bondi-forester.description: Each Bondi provides 10 Wood every minute up to a maximum of 250 Wood per minute.

danevirke.name: Danevirke
danevirke.description: Converts Palisades to Danevirke walls, which have +1000 increased health and 5 fire armor.

extra-oars.name: Extra Oars
extra-oars.description: Increases the hold size of Longships by +6 and increases weapon damage by +1.

farmathr.name: Farmathr
farmathr.description: Increases Trader and Trade Ship health by 25% and movement speed by 10%.

farmstead.name: Farmstead
farmstead.description:
The Longhouse becomes a Food dropoff and adds two workable vegetable fields that can be gathered from 50% faster than a farm. Increases Longhouse health by 500.
Limited to 6 Farmstead upgraded Longhouses.

folkekirken.name: Folkekirken
folkekirken.description: Increases population and maximum population by +10.

hagl-brodda.name: Hagl Brodda
hagl-brodda.description: The Archer unleashes a hail of arrows when attacking, firing 2 additional arrows at random nearby locations that do 3 less damage.

hamrammr.name: Hamrammr
hamrammr.description: Berserkergang triggers at 50% health and heals +50% more health.

leding.name: Leding
leding.description: The Dock influence will also increase ship production speed by 5% for each Longhouse up to 20%.

leikr-training.name: Leikr Training
leikr-training.description: Physical sports or games that improve the weapon skills and agility of infantry. Melee Infantry gain +15% damage, +20% health, and +0.3 tile weapon range.

pasture-and-loom.name: Pasture and Loom
pasture-and-loom.description:
Automatically researches melee and ranged armor technologies. Technologies from previous ages will research 60 seconds faster. Increases Longhouse health by 750.
Limited to 1 Pasture and Loom upgraded Longhouse.

reinforced-keel.name: Reinforced Keel
reinforced-keel.description: Increases ship health by +25% and ranged armor by +1.

ship-barding.name: Ship Barding
ship-barding.description: Increases the health of all military ships by +25% and ranged armor by +1.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.description:
Automatically researches melee and ranged damage technologies. Technologies from previous ages will research 60 seconds faster. Increases Longhouse health by 750.
Limited to 1 Smithy upgraded Longhouse.

snaerisspjot.name: Snaerisspjot
snaerisspjot.description: Changes the Drakkar weapon to throwing spears which have +2 damage and +1 range.

sunstones.name: Sunstones
sunstones.description: Increases ship vision range by +50% and movement speed by +15%.

turnshoes.name: Turnshoes
turnshoes.description: Increases Melee Infantry movement speed by +15% and charge damage by +30%.

ulfberht-swords.name: Ulfberht Swords
ulfberht-swords.description: Hirdmen equip Ulfberht Swords, increasing their damage by +5.

elite-berserker.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-berserker.description: Upgrade Veteran Berserker to Elite Berserker.

elite-bondi.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-bondi.description: Upgrade Veteran Bondi to Elite Bondi.

elite-jylland-knight.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-jylland-knight.description: Upgrade Jylland Knight to Elite Jylland Knight.

elite-sk-ne-crossbowmen.name: Upgrade to Elite
elite-sk-ne-crossbowmen.description: Upgrade Skåne Crossbowmen to Elite Skåne Crossbowmen.

veteran-berserker.name: Upgrade to Veteran
veteran-berserker.description: Upgrade Hardened Berserker to Veteran Berserker.

veteran-bondi.name: Upgrade to Veteran
veteran-bondi.description: Upgrade Hardened Bondi to Veteran Bondi.

baugr-fort.name: Baugr Fort
baugr-fort.description:
Acts as a Barracks with all units and technologies. All Barracks work +25% faster and reduces Barracks technology costs by 15%.
Immediately upgrades Bondi and Berserkers to Hardened.

konungr-hall.name: Konungr Hall
konungr-hall.description:
Hosts a feast every 60 seconds which provides 10 Food +5 Food for each Longhouse and has a one-time Shield Maiden rally.
Can recruit Shield Maidens up to 1 +1 for each Longhouse constructed.

gullinn-temple.name: Gullinn Temple
gullinn-temple.description: Acts as a Sacred Grove. Allows Völur to establish Sacred Groves on Sacred Sites and unlock the Dreki Saga which increases Sacred Grove Berserker production by 15%.

valdemar-castle.name: Valdemar Castle
valdemar-castle.description: Acts as a Keep. Grants the Danevirke technology which replaces Palisades with stronger walls that have +5 fire armor. Jylland Knights grant 20 more Gold when they are killed.

kongens-d-r-cathedral.name: Kongens Dør Cathedral
kongens-d-r-cathedral.description: Acts as a Monastery. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Has a slowly expanding area that gathers a tithe of 12.5 Gold for each Longhouse every 30 seconds. Has a unique technology that further increases maximum population.

rikets-nyckel-castle.name: Rikets Nyckel Castle
rikets-nyckel-castle.description: Acts as a Keep that fires volleys of arrows. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Reduces the cost of all unit tier technologies by 50%. Recruits 10 Skåne Crossbowmen upon construction completion.

dreki-stave-church.name: Dreki Stave Church
dreki-stave-church.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

zx.name: Zhu Xi's Legacy
zx.description: The teachings of philosopher Zhu Xi reshape the Chinese civilization. With Zhu Xi’s Legacy, the Chinese boast a sophisticated administration with superior Imperial Officials and advanced technologies. The brimming treasury helps to establish powerful dynasties and research a breadth of unique technologies. Recruit Palace Guards, Zhuge Nus, and Grenadiers early on to protect the Empire.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Begin in the Tang Dynasty - Landmark costs are reduced by -15% and the Village is unlocked.
Enter a new Dynasty by building both Landmarks from an Age to unlock special bonuses and buildings.
Units trained, technologies researched, and resources dropped off generate tax (Gold) that can be collected by Imperial Officials.
Unique technologies massively upgrade Imperial Officials, unlock new units and boost military units.
Early Palace Guards are available in the Feudal Age.
Access the Zhuge Nu and Grenadier without entering Dynasties.
Villagers construct defenses +50% faster and all other buildings +100% faster.
Chemistry technology granted for free in the Dark Age - Town Centers, Keeps, and Outposts use Handcannon Slits instead of Defensive Arrowslits.
Docks work +10% faster.

overview.title: Great Dynasties
overview.description:
Start your journey in the Tang Dynasty - Landmark costs are reduced by -15% and the Village is unlocked.
Construct both Landmarks in an Age to start Dynasties with special bonuses, unique buildings, and units.
• Song: Wood cost of Economy and Population buildings is discounted by -30% - unlocks construction of the Granary.
• Yuan: 10% discount on all units - unlocks construction of the Pagoda.
• Ming: Unique Units deal +20% damage.

overview.title: Taxes
overview.description: Units trained, technologies researched, and resources dropped off generate tax (Gold) that can be collected by Imperial Officials. Unique administrative technologies from the Mount Lu Academy and Zhu Xi's Library vastly improve Imperial Officials.

overview.title: Dynasty Units
overview.description: Access the Zhuge Nu and the Grenadier without establishing dynasties. Landmarks can unlock powerful Shaolin Monks, Yuan Raiders, and Imperial Guards. Early Palace Guards can be trained in the Feudal Age.

overview.title: Masters of Gunpowder
overview.description: Begin the game with Chemistry technology granted for free - defensive buildings use Handcannon Slits over Defensive Arrowslits.

overview.title: Rapid Fabrications
overview.description: Villagers construct defenses +50% faster and all other buildings +100% faster. Docks work +10% faster.

overview.title: Protect the Palace
overview.description: Train Early Palace Guards in the Feudal Age (II) to protect the emperor.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Imperial Official: Use the Supervise ability to boost the production speed of research and military buildings by +150% - supervising economic buildings increases the amount of resources dropped off by Villagers by +20%.
Zhuge Nu: Archer replacement. Light ranged infantry with a rapid burst attack effective vs. light units.
Palace Guard: Man-at-Arms replacement. Heavy melee infantry that exchanges armor for move speed.
Nest of Bees: Mangonel replacement. Siege engine that fires a barrage of rockets, doing area of effect damage.
Grenadier: Light ranged gunpowder infantry that throws grenades dealing area of effect damage.

imperial-official.description:
Economic support unit with no combat capability. Automatically gathers Tax (Gold) from buildings.
+ Can supervise buildings to improve their efficiency
- Only a certain number of Officials can exist at a time

imperial-retinue.description: Spawns an army of 4 Yuan Raiders and 1 Imperial Guard.

Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

- Weak if surrounded

Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

yuan-raider.description:
Extremely swift light cavalry which deals bonus damage to economic units.
+ Fast move speed
+ Bonus damage vs Villagers

- Countered by Spearmen

zhuge-nu.description:
Fires bolts with a ferocious damage potential against enemy units.
+ High rate of fire
- Ineffective vs high ranged armor targets
- Countered by Horsemen

10000-bolts.name: 10000 Bolts
10000-bolts.description: Zhuge Nu and Crossbowmen fire an extra bolt. The additional bolt for Crossbowmen is 40% as effective as the previous bolt.

additional-barrels.name: Additional Barrels
additional-barrels.description: Nest of Bees receive 3 additional Rocket Arrows.

advanced-administration.name: Advanced Administration
advanced-administration.description: Imperial Officials gain 150 health and their maximum Gold carried is increased by +80. Imperial Official limit increased by +2.

bolt-magazines.name: Bolt Magazines
bolt-magazines.description: More advanced magazines allow Zhuge Nu to fire piercing bolts with +0.5 range that deal +1 damage against Light Melee Infantry.

cloud-of-terror.name: Cloud of Terror
cloud-of-terror.description: Adds area of effect damage to Bombards.

dali-horses.name: Dali Horses
dali-horses.description: Increase the attack speed of Cavalry units by +20%.

dynastic-protectors.name: Dynastic Protectors
dynastic-protectors.description: Allows production of unique cavalry units, the Imperial Guard, and the Yuan Raider.

handcannon-slits.name: Handcannon Slits
handcannon-slits.description: Add defensive handcannon slits to this structure and increases garrison arrow range by +1. Only one weapon emplacement can be added.

hard-cased-bombs.name: Hard Cased Bombs
hard-cased-bombs.description: Enemy units receive +15% Ranged and Melee damage for 5 seconds when hit by a Grenade.

imperial-red-seals.name: Imperial Red Seals
imperial-red-seals.description: Imperial Official limit increased by +2. Grants an Imperial Official upon completion.

military-affairs-bureau.name: Military Affairs Bureau
military-affairs-bureau.description: Imperial Officials can now supervise Keeps and Outposts to reduce damage taken by 35%.

regional-inspection.name: Regional Inspection
regional-inspection.description: Supervision by Imperial Officials improved from 150% to 300%.

roar-of-the-dragon.name: Roar of the Dragon
roar-of-the-dragon.description: Spearmen and Horsemen gain a Fire Lance when charging.

thunderclap-bombs.name: Thunderclap Bombs
thunderclap-bombs.description: Warships fire a Nest of Bees attack.

jiangnan-tower.name: Jiangnan Tower
jiangnan-tower.description:
Acts as a tax drop-off for Imperial Officials.
Military Buildings and Military Units produced within influence award progress towards free armies. Each free army requires progressively more resources to be spent than the last, until 12 armies have been produced.

meditation-gardens.name: Meditation Gardens
meditation-gardens.description:
Increases the resource value of nearby gold veins, stone outcroppings, and berry bushes by +5% every 30 seconds up to a maximum of +60%.
Trees are increased at a lesser rate of +2.5% up to +30%.
After 330 seconds, generates resources equal to 5% of the current resources in those nearby deposits. Additionally generates 5% of the maximum resources of each deposit when fully gathered.

mount-lu-academy.name: Mount Lu Academy
mount-lu-academy.description:
Imperial Officials collect tax twice as often and also collect 20% of taxes as Food.
Contains unique upgrades that greatly improve the Imperial Official unit.

shaolin-monastery.name: Shaolin Monastery
shaolin-monastery.description: Unique Monastery capable of producing Shaolin Monks. From the Yuan Dynasty onwards, Shaolin Monks can also be produced from Pagodas.

temple-of-the-sun.name: Temple of the Sun
temple-of-the-sun.description: Activate powerful abilities that improve speed, damage, range, or regeneration of specific units.

zhu-xis-library.name: Zhu Xi's Library
zhu-xis-library.description:
Hosts a range of highly unique upgrades.
Can unlock Yuan Raiders and Imperial Guards. Only 2 technologies can be researched.
